name: JohnFetterman.com
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Take a look if you can today:
#
Hey, Derek -- so we're almost at our end-of-quarter FEC deadline.
It’s literally just over 24 hours away.
Remember, that's when we’re legally required to report out all our latest fundraising numbers to the FEC. The press (and our GOP opponents) are going to scour these numbers and gauge our momentum.
A lot of donations? _That means John Fetterman has the momentum to win._
Too few donations? _That makes our team look beatable._
Because this is high stakes stuff, we generally try to make a really big push right before the closing deadline. Which you, uh, may have noticed by looking at your inbox.
Derek, the honest-to-goodness truth is, we're still behind on our goal for the quarter. And if we don't see a quick surge of support, we could miss it.
[**Our average donation this quarter is just $23.28. Can you make a donation of that amount — or whatever you can afford — today to help us meet our goal of 200,000 unique donors?**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46140?refcode=em20220330-5191&t=4&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46140?refcode=em20220330-5191&t=5&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)
**[DONATE $23.28 »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46141?refcode=em20220330-5191&t=6&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)**
Allow us to dive further into our average donation amount and why it matters so much.
When we first launched our campaign, our average donation was in the $31 range. Throughout the past year, we’ve watched that number dip as low as $18. Now, we're at $23.28.
In a weird way, we're proud of it! Here's why:
A low average donation is the hallmark of a real people-powered campaign. It shows that we’re not funded by corporate PACs or billionaires with deep pockets.
But, on the other hand, it means the money we used to raise from two donations — well, now we need three to raise the same amount!
**We can't afford to miss our goal because of the aforementioned high stakes — reporters, media narratives, etc.** So, we're asking everyone who hasn't donated to make their very first contribution to John Fetterman today — that'll help us close the gap.
**[Can you make your first $5 donation right now to help John Fetterman reach our FEC end-of-quarter goal? Every donation helps us show the strength and size of this grassroots campaign to flip PA blue.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46140?refcode=em20220330-5191&t=7&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)**
**[Contribute»](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46140?refcode=em20220330-5191&t=26&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)**
Look, if you can give ANY amount at all today, that makes you a hero in our books. Seriously, it means a lot to us.
If you can't give today, we understand, and that's OK too.
**At the end of the day, we're proud that we're the only campaign in this race with over 500,000+ grassroots contributions.** It says a lot about the kind of inclusive, grassroots movement we’re building. And it means a lot when it comes to flipping a swing state like Pennsylvania.
Thank you for all you do.
— Team Fetterman
P.S. Even if you can't donate $23.28 or anywhere near our average donation, your contribution of even a modest amount *really* helps add up on our FEC report. And if you're the kind of person who can afford to give more, that helps a lot, too. **[So, please, consider making a donation now before our deadline hits.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46140?refcode=em20220330-5191&t=27&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)**

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220330-5191-footer&t=28&refcode2=5191_434096_ZPMh15&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)**
---
[](https://www.facebook.com/JohnFettermanPA/) | [](https://twitter.com/johnfetterman) | [](https://www.instagram.com/johnfetterman/)
Email us: info@johnfetterman.com
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Fetterman for PA, PO Box 6061, Pittsburgh PA 15211.
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.johnfetterman.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/)
* [Update My Personal Information](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/personal_info/?t=29&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.johnfetterman.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=30&akid=5191%2E434096%2EZPMh15)

name: Adam Kinzinger
subject: Something different
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Country First
body:
| [ ](http://www.country1st.com/?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=1)
---
Friend -- Donald Trump just publicly asked Putin to dig up dirt on the Biden Family; Tucker Carlson keeps hand-feeding Kremlin propaganda to his audience; the 1/6 Committee continues to uncover disturbing evidence regarding the very real attempt to overthrow our government. **But that's _not_ what this email is about**. I've often criticized the breathless, fear-inducing, sky-is-falling fundraising emails that come this time of month. But guess what? Sadly, they work. After all, fear is one of the most powerful motivators. But imagine, just for a moment (and however skeptically), an America in which our leaders sought to inspire us; dared us to imagine politics and problem solving differently; appealed to the best in us instead of the worst. That's a country I believe reasonable people of goodwill want to live in. [That's the nation Country First is fighting to create for our kids and grandkids.](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=2) Country First is a home for good, reasonable people from across the spectrum, but especially those who recognize that neither party's bosses put the country above their political interests. And according to just about every poll out there: The politically homeless are the disenfranchised majority in America. We have the power to take on the failed politics of today, and bring truth and accountability back to government. And, sure, it helps that my profile allows me to go on TV and promote our mission, but the _real_ change is going to come from the grassroots. That work doesn't come cheap, but I can assure you we have _fantastic_ volunteers and leaders who allow us to dramatically multiply the impact of every dollar invested with us. [So, yes, if you're in a position to do so, I am asking for your most generous gift to our cause](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=3) \-- but not by appealing to our shared fear of what our nation will become if we do nothing, but by appealing to our shared hope that, together, we can leave our kids and grandkids a saner, healthier, and more hopeful country. | [](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=4 "Every Gift Adds Up to a Big Impact") [Every Gift Adds Up to a Big Impact](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=4)
---
I've included below a summary of the awesome grassroots work we're doing, and hope you'll get involved however you can. It's people like you -- who through contributing or volunteering or spreading the word or all of the above -- bring this movement to life. And I'm grateful.
Country First,
Adam
* * *
**COUNTRY FIRST GRASSROOTS UPDATE**
**UNIFY CHALLENGE**
Country First is proud to announce our Unify Challenge, where we'll link two people for a live one-on-one online conversation (like Zoom) who may live across the country and/or have a different outlook on things. It’s not a debate. It’s an invitation to have a productive, open, guided conversation with a fellow American to find common ground and talk about issues our country faces. Sign up for one of the following sessions:
* [**Tuesday, April 5 at 1pm ET**](https://www.country1st.com/challenge?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=5)
* [**Thursday, April 7 at 8pm ET**](https://www.country1st.com/challenge?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=6)

This is a great opportunity to share with your family, friends, colleagues, neighbors, and/or classmates. We think this will be an incredibly valuable program, so please do not miss out!
[](https://www.country1st.com/challenge?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=7 "Enroll in the Unify Challenge") [Enroll in the Unify Challenge](https://www.country1st.com/challenge?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=7)
---
* * *
**PRIMARY FIRST & STATE CHAPTERS**
Country First state chapter leaders are currently undergoing training and meeting about best ways to organize around Primary First – our first-of-its-kind primary election strategy to take on the most toxic partisans. _ICYMI – Primary First was successful in Texas! Voters in the 68th District of TX rejected the pro-insurrection candidate running in the GOP primary. Thank you to our Texas members for their hard work in organizing around this plan!_
There is a ton of excitement for this aspect of the movement. Trust me when I say that our National Grassroots Team and state organizing committees are working tirelessly to lay the foundation for robust conversations, candidate tracking, idea sharing, and community development.
Over the next month, be on the lookout for an invitation to join state-based online communities. Additionally, if you would like to join your state organizing committee to help educate others in your state about elections and plan engagement opportunities, email [kalah@country1st.com](mailto:kalah@country1st.com) or [dilan@country1st.com](mailto:dilan@country1st.com).
* * *
**NEXT GENERATION ENGAGEMENT PROGRAM**
Country First is currently recruiting college students all across the country to participate in our Next Generation Engagement Program. Through this program, students who are often forced to choose between highly partisan and toxic campus political organizations will have the opportunity to join our movement, learn about our mission, and become a leader on their campus. Campus organizers from university campuses will work together in this program to provide recommendations to the movement, lead national initiatives, and ensure our next generation is putting country before party.
If you know of any college students interested in joining the movement, please share the below form with them or have them contact [eric.odriscoll@country1st.com](mailto:eric.odriscoll@country1st.com) or [vera.chaudhry@country1st.com](mailto:vera.chaudhry@country1st.com).
[](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=KFozupC4hMau3PknCEub8o1TIHa0t0kUBTRKldYruqdfhsZE5JySqlFD--xpmcDE&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=8 "NextGen Interest Form") [NextGen Interest Form](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=KFozupC4hMau3PknCEub8o1TIHa0t0kUBTRKldYruqdfhsZE5JySqlFD--xpmcDE&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=8)
---
* * *
**PRIVATE FACEBOOK COMMUNITY**
With over 1,300 active members, our private Facebook community has proven that respectful civil discourse is ready to take its place back on our social media timelines. Our moderators have launched a challenge for 500+ individuals to share their story on why they joined the movement. Outside all of the noise and turbulence, it is imperative we check in with one another, discuss our origins, and take mental benchmarks together. We look forward to hearing what brought you to the movement and learning from your perspective. If you are interested in joining the moderators committee, please email [emily@country1st.com](mailto:emily@country1st.com).
[](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=9 "Join our Private Facebook Community") [Join our Private Facebook Community](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=9)
---
* * *
[](https://www.country1st.com/shop?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=10 "Wear your Values") [Wear your Values](https://www.country1st.com/shop?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_1q_nd&n=10)

|
March 30, 2022
Today, Fremont County Sheriff Allen Cooper announced his endorsement of Erik Aadland for the U.S. House of Representatives Colorado District 7 (CD7). Cooper was elected Sheriff in 2018 with over 61% of the vote. He is well liked and very well respected in Fremont County. Sheriff Cooper has achieved excellent results in overhauling the Fremont County Sheriff's Office and received accolades for solving stubborn cold cases he inherited upon taking office.

"Erik Aadland is my choice for our next Congressman because he understands the needs of communities like ours in Fremont County. I believe in Erik's ability to fight government overreach and protect state and local governance. Knowing that as a combat veteran Erik risked his life in support of his oath to defend the Constitution makes it easy for me to trust in his character and integrity facing this crucial task. I think often of my two sons who are currently serving in our military, and I would be proud to see the good people of Fremont County represented in Washington by one of their brothers in arms. Erik is well prepared to be the kind of servant leader that we need in Congress."

'I am grateful to have Sheriff Cooper's endorsement," said Erik. "He serves the people of Fremont County well, and his support is important as my campaign continues to build a successful and winning organization."

clean_body: Sheriff Allen Cooper is all in for Erik! | | | | == | | Fremont County Sheriff Cooper endorses Erik for Congress | | ---|--- | March 30, 2022 Today, Fremont County Sheriff Allen Cooper announced his endorsement of Erik Aadland for the U.S. House of Representatives Colorado District 7 (CD7). Cooper was elected Sheriff in 2018 with over 61% of the vote. He is well liked and very well respected in Fremont County. Sheriff Cooper has achieved excellent results in overhauling the Fremont County Sheriff's Office and received accolades for solving stubborn cold cases he inherited upon taking office. "Erik Aadland is my choice for our next Congressman because he understands the needs of communities like ours in Fremont County. I believe in Erik's ability to fight government overreach and protect state and local governance. Knowing that as a combat veteran Erik risked his life in support of his oath to defend the Constitution makes it easy for me to trust in his character and integrity facing this crucial task. I think often of my two sons who are currently serving in our military, and I would be proud to see the good people of Fremont County represented in Washington by one of their brothers in arms. Erik is well prepared to be the kind of servant leader that we need in Congress." 'I am grateful to have Sheriff Cooper's endorsement," said Erik. No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to “ _bring it.”_ [**Well, I’m counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency End of Quarter donation to my campaign.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv7uv1ci1dcjni2pe2u494cd1f9n30p4kkogr42o_) [**DONATE NOW TO FIRE LIZ CHENEY**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpgktssb5ej8137c534q0079jh2gaj1p2ul2t35g_) You and I don’t have a moment to lose... That’s because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise _millions_ for Cheney. That was even after Cheney admitted in a _60 Minutes_ interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by _Democrats_. If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it’s now. And it’s against Liz Cheney. [**Will you help me with an urgent donation before Cheney beats us in Quarter 1 fundraisng?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ze2gjmnru77mb3hss60tsfn0j5hock6o7aalr2to_) I’m getting ahead of myself. Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.** My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home. Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age. They’re not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party. . . and sold out our country to the highest bidder. **I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was dupped by these same “Republicans.”** **And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton’s EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned**** _our_****conservative values.** Unfortunately, it’s only gotten worse since President Trump left office. And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me! [**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. I need your help before we fall short of our Quarter 1 fundraising goal!**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8f58qg3d8kna75pftebjfdbhjj9bgdlibcl4ogo_) [**DONATE NOW TO FIRE LIZ CHENEY**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zdahof5107qa24mis5hjpfap2b3ph3cnujmp7ud8_) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me**. He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I’ll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress. In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government. In Washington, I promise to do the same... ...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars,_ _fling open our borders,_ and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree! **But even though I have President Trump’s complete and total endorsement, there’s one endorsement I still need:****_yours. _** [**Will you make an emergency End of Quarter campaign donation to let me know I have it?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zctabo901hv8qu6igg0dc077hcd10qpo3pui5560_) [**DONATE NOW TO FIRE LIZ CHENEY**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztr5t2dsel3ng2238n75tl4a14o4co3tbre44h0g_) You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election. **In fact, when liberal**** _60 Minutes_****asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said “****absolutely****...****this is going to be the most important House race in the country****.”** Well, she was right about something – this _will_ be the most important race in the entire country – but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden. Again, I’ll need your help to beat her. As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment. That’s not even saying anything for her _left-wing_ supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party _for good_. **But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing**** _for good. _** [**So please, won’t you ensure that Liz Cheney doesn't show an early lead by beating us in Q1 fundraising and make an emergency campaign donation to FIRE Liz Cheney right away?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg00ep10eveugrmkglejmal38sqo5utm4nilvlsg_) [**DONATE NOW TO FIRE LIZ CHENEY**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvdogdkv3fj0a3vp12jdf54dfsit6vki2mse6ncg_) Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against. Will you help me make sure we win that fight? Respectfully, Harriet Hageman America First Conservative for Congress (WY) PS: It’s disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi’s unconstitutional power grabs in Congress. It’s even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America. [**No more – will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmle7g9fekkmup4m94q3pl997ohtqef87a73mi38_) [**DONATE NOW TO FIRE LIZ CHENEY**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqao34gi29gj9qh1n1acvvlkk5hddms1tkpbdhco_) [Privacy Policy](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z75ruio9heei9r9d8jc0puqj7cgeoflib6p87aug_rp22sh2s8i66ob0sth60o76cph2bs) | 2020 All Rights Reserved | info@HagemanforWyoming.com P.O. Friend,

Helping Val Demings defeat Sen. Marco Rubio in Florida is deeply personal to me – and my determination to send Sen. Rubio packing began just a week after the worst day of my life.
**_Fir_** _st,_ Marco Rubio spoke on gun safety at a town hall just seven days after my daughter, Jaime, was murdered at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. He couldn't even look at me when I confronted him about restricting access to assault weapons like the one that killed my Jaime. Ever since then, Marco Rubio has remorselessly opposed even bipartisan efforts to reduce gun violence.
_**But then** ,_ Democrats took back the House. Bold change-makers like Congresswoman Val Demings passed commonsense, lifesaving gun safety reform. And in the Senate, Marco Rubio – the gun lobby's lackey – ensured the laws we _need_ to curb the gun violence epidemic in this country would never see the light of day.

My son Jazz needs 48 more people to step up and donate to his campaign for Congress before midnight tonight. Will you chip in whatever you can right away so he can win this open seat for progress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=top_link1]
Donate now » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=top_btn]
Hi there, it’s Priscilla, Jazz’s mom.
Raising our children, Jazz’s father and I fought to give them the best start in life. We were so proud when Jazz became an Eagle Scout and a college graduate.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=body_img1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=body_img1]But even though we fought to give our kids every opportunity we could, Jazz saw firsthand how our community needs greater access to health care. When his father got sick, Jazz took care of him. Sometimes they couldn’t even get a doctor’s appointment or the life-sustaining medication they needed.
So you know what my son did? Jazz ran for Maryland Delegate and helped bring health care providers to low-income areas and the first cardiac care unit to Prince George’s County.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=body_img2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=body_img2]Jazz has delivered results for our community, and he’s ready to take his work to the next level and become the effective voice for progress that we need in Congress.
But here’s the thing, our family isn’t wealthy. We fought our way to the middle class. That means Jazz is counting on grassroots supporters like you to fuel this people-powered campaign so he can keep reaching voters and win this critical open seat for progress.
Will you be one of the 48 people he needs to chip in before midnight tonight to meet his end-of-quarter goal so he can take his fight for Prince George’s County, and other communities like it around the country, to Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=body_link1]

Priscilla Ferebee
(Jazz’s mom)
Jazz Lewis [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/Jazz-Lewis-Portrait.png]
Jazz Lewis is an effective progressive leader running for the Democratic nomination in Maryland’s 4th Congressional District. A champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus.
Jazz would be the youngest African-American ever elected to represent Maryland in Congress. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son.

subject: It’s the last day of Women’s History Month
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Peter,

When we elect Nikki this November, we’re going to bring something new to Florida — not just because Nikki will be a real fighter for all Floridians, but because she’ll be making history as the first woman and first Jewish woman to hold the Governor’s office.

I don’t know about you, but I think that’s a pretty big deal. And I think we should celebrate by helping Nikki reach her March fundraising goal.

Today is the LAST day of Women’s History Month, and Team Nikki is hard at work raising money to elect Florida’s first woman Governor. Can you help us celebrate women’s history and chip in $10 before tonight’s deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-mar-2022?refcode=331eom7]

This legislative session sent Florida women a clear message — Ron DeSantis and his GOP allies don’t care about our health, safety, or well-being.

But this year, we have the chance to replace him with a woman who’s never wavered in her support for women’s rights and who will always be a proud, outspoken advocate for ALL Florida women.

And you can help us do it, Peter. Click here to chip in $10 before Women’s History Month ends. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-mar-2022?refcode=331eom7]

Thanks!
— Marissa

Hey, it's Conor.

It's a busy day, and I only have a few minutes before my next meeting. But my team told me that later today they're sending you a final fundraising update before the FEC deadline tonight, and I wanted to write you a quick note first with some honest thoughts, directly from me.

This will be little different than other emails you might be getting from other Democratic campaigns right now. I don't have any fancy graphics for you or big flashing letters saying that our campaign will fall apart unless you rush a donation right away.

But this is incredibly important, so I hope you'll read it anyway.

Trump recently unendorsed Republican Alabama Senate Candidate Mo Brooks – because Brooks wouldn't commit to illegally “rescind” the 2020 election, remove President Biden and force a new special election.

**Now Trump says he's planning to endorse one of my Republican opponents in the Pennsylvania Senate race, and it's clear what Trump wants in exchange for his endorsement.** The stakes of this race are far from normal — we're fighting against an ongoing attack on the core of American democracy.

We cannot afford to lose this race.

That's why my team and I have put together a bold, ambitious ground game to win this ultra-competitive Senate seat, and we have a new TV ad bringing our message all over Pennsylvania. _How can they be expected to serve the American people when they’re barely willing to stand up to our socialist enemies?_

**Congress needs a kick in the behind to GET TO WORK and do their jobs, and I’m ready to give them just that - but I need your help.**

**The FIRST end-of-quarter deadline of our race is HERE, and if we don’t make this goal, we’ll NEVER be able to bring our Green Beret values to Washington.**

**[Pitch in before 11:59 PM TONIGHT so we can meet this critical goal and GET TO WORK for the American people.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c27090%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VjFJpqa8vyIjds%2baC1%2bP%2bw&sysid=1)** [**PITCH IN $10**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c27091%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fTj5KSUkEgrOfwSd7qmCJw&sysid=1) [**PITCH IN $25**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c27092%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FVNhHJW2sTFLiO%2f8ESF2lQ&sysid=1) [**PITCH IN $50**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c27093%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=C3KH2LaXMHD7ARLPVHGqkg&sysid=1) [**PITCH IN $100**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c27094%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Qc37QkjWsMfwMF%2f1jgFDYQ&sysid=1) [**PITCH IN $250**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c27005%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZCdD5RjWuKD1ND0GkUUGDA&sysid=1) [**PITCH IN ANY OTHER AMOUNT**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c27006%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YZjvFzCv6odnLNaL4EG7LA&sysid=1) Over my time in the Army, I got used to seeing everyone not just do their jobs, but strive to be the _best_ they could be for our country.

**And they’re letting America’s strength slip between their fingers while they dine at 5-star restaurants.**

Before I give it to him later today, will you take a moment to sign his birthday card?

Being a senator has been the honor of Patrick’s life, and this will be his last celebration while in office. Will you help me make it an extra-special birthday by taking just a minute to sign his birthday card?

Thanks so much for all your support of Patrick over the years – it means so much to both of us.

Marcelle Leahy

From: Marcelle Leahy
Date: Wed, March 30, 2022
Subject: My husband's birthday

Friend,

Tomorrow is my husband Patrick's birthday, and it's a special one: the last one he will celebrate as a sitting senator.

I'm hoping you can help me make it extra-meaningful for him. Representing the people of Vermont and serving the American people has been the honor of Patrick's life. I know nothing would mean more to him than hearing from his supporters and many friends he's met along the way.

Will you take a moment to sign Patrick's birthday card? You're also welcome to leave him a note to share with him your best wishes.

SIGN THE CARD » https://links.e.leahyforvermont.com/els/v2/qkjvQ_6~PqT4/ZHhqRFVMZjZ6Vk4vSTdwdlNhbnhBcHhlaUoyN3VMZzhSTWx5WUVhOGxvb1R6MmZ6MVdmTzB2eVlGRmFNVU5VR3NtQ0htNkV6cmRwMHlGaVJoZmVzamhXMzVvaXVtbDB5WVd1M2VCUDFvZGM9S0/

While Patrick's time in the senate is nearing an end, he's as focused-as-ever as he fights for the American people. After leading passage of a bipartisan budget bill, he has turned his attention to fulfilling his constitutional duty by participating in the historic confirmation hearings for Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson.

On top of his senatorial duties, Patrick is also working hard every-day to make sure that he leaves the senate in good hands next year. With all on his plate, I know that he'll enjoy taking a moment to feel celebrated by seeing folks from across the country sign his card.

Please, join me in showing your support and appreciation for Patrick by wishing him a happy birthday before his birthday tomorrow.

Thank you for helping me make Patrick's last birthday in the United State Senate a special one.

Sincerely,

Marcelle Leahy

body:
Hi Team,
Thank you to those who have already signed up!
Current top needs, *specifically this Saturday, April 2!*

*Canvassing - Door Knocking in Morton and Albright in Alamance County from
8am-12pm* *this Saturday, April 2.* Meet at Fresh Artisan Market, 2656
Darrell Newton Dr
<https://www.google.com/maps/search/2656+Darrell+Newton+Dr?entry=gmail&source=g>
in
Graham, Table 5. We will help set up the table for Swepsonville Day,
discuss the plan for the day and leave from there.
Please sign up here:
*https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-canvassing
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-canvassing>*
*After signing up, I will contact you regarding the Campaign Sidekick App.*

*Swepsonville Day* - This Saturday, April 2 *Fresh Artisan Market, 2656
Darrell Newton Dr
<https://www.google.com/maps/search/2656+Darrell+Newton+Dr?entry=gmail&source=g>
in
Graham. Table 5 *Table manning and take down, 2 people from 2:00-5:00.
Please sign up here:
*https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-swepsonville
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-swepsonville>*

*THESE ARE ONGOING:*
*Call Fire Department Chiefs in these counties*, Person, Granville, Orange
and Durham. Schedule times for Courtney to stop by the station to say hello
and introduce herself to the first responders. A script and list will be
provided. *We need at least 3-5 people.*

*Attend events that Courtney is attending or represent her in her absence.*

*Thursday, April 28 from 6:30-7:30pm* - Attend the Granville GOP monthly
meeting. When they open the floor for anyone to speak, introduce yourself
as a representative for Courtney Geels, running for US Congress in District
4. Any questions, to see you and have palm cards to hand out.

*Host a phone banking party.* Gather neighbors, friends and family at your
house or a central location to phone bank! We need to do this twice/week
from now until Election Day! Want to do it alone? You can do that too! It's
very simple and the time goes fast!

*Host a Meet and Greet.* It can be at your home, a restaurant or bar!
Invite neighbors, friends and family in District 4 to meet Courtney and ask
her questions.

*Recruit friends and family to help you for any of these needs. You will be
supported, coached and given everything you need to be successful. Please
either sign up or let me know where you want to volunteer.*

Courtney will be at a Town Hall along with her opposing candidate, Robert
Thomas on *Tuesday, April 19, 7:00pm *at the Durham GOP headquarters.
Please attend and bring some friends!

Follow us on Twitter <https://twitter.com/courtneygeels>, Instagram
<https://www.instagram.com/courtneygeels/>, and give us a like on Facebook
<https://www.facebook.com/CourtneyGeelsForCongress> to keep up with
Courtney.
Be sure to like and share!

Brad Kirby is our Social Media Director. Please reach out to him at *m
<bkirby7@gmail.com>edia@courtneygeelsforcongress.com
<edia@courtneygeelsforcongress.com>* if you would like to help him in any
way and send him photos of you campaigning for Courtney.

*Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity together!*Laurie Teper
Volunteer Coordinator
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com
Cell: (847)212-5651
courtneygeelsforcongress.com

body:
Hey Peter,

It’s Bryan, Senior Advisor to Adam Hattersley’s campaign.

We’re less than 24 hours away from the end of the month, and after crunching the numbers, it looks like we still need your help. This is a major deadline, and we’re $5,233 short of our goal.

To defeat the wildly corrupt Jimmy Patronis, we’re going to need to finish our first month strong. Click here to chip in now and help Adam win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ah-email-march-2022?refcode=331]

Jimmy’s performance as Chief Financial Officer has been an embarrassment to Florida. He’s left us in a bigger mess than when he started and has done the bare minimum to address the affordability crisis, insurance rates, or any of the other financial issues facing Florida residents.

This is why we need new leadership, and this is why we need Adam.

Adam retired from the military as a highly decorated Naval Officer, served the people of Florida in the House of Representatives, and still managed to find time to be a business owner, author, and a dedicated husband.

Adam will put us first at every turn. Can you rush a donation today to help us reach our goal and get Adam one step closer to winning this race? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ah-email-march-2022?refcode=331]

To stop Jimmy, we need to get our message to as many people as we can. We’re ready to go out across Florida to listen and to learn what issues are most important to you.

Adam sees himself as a public servant, not a politician, and he will do whatever he can to amplify the voices of those who have been silenced by partisan politics and career politicians like Jimmy Patronis and Ron DeSantis.

But we can only do it with your help. Click here to chip in now and help us finish our first month strong. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ah-email-march-2022?refcode=331]

We are so grateful for your support.

-Bryan

Friend,
I’m reaching out today because I have a big favor to ask. Today is the last day for us to raise towards our end-of-quarter fundraising goal, and we need help!
This is an election year. And an important one. Lawmakers up and down the ticket decide the fate of West Virginians, and not all candidates deserve that power. For far too long we’ve watched reckless legislation from the West Virginia GOP leaving our families behind. They’re more concerned with protecting corporations and lobby groups than the people who live and breathe West Virginia air.
The WVDP has big plans. Politics isn’t business as usual in this country, and that is a good thing. We need to shake things up. But first we need to make sure that we have the resources we need to do so.
So will you please consider making a donation right now, and helping the WVDP support, recruit, train, and mobilize? We have until midnight. Thank you in advance! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/wv]

Belinda Biafore, Chair, WVDP

name: Steve Sisolak (personal)
subject: What we’re up against
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Authorized by Committee to Elect Steve Sisolak
body:
Friends, I was born into a working-class family. It wasn’t always easy, but it taught me to value hard work and community. Lessons that helped me raise my two daughters as a single father. It’s those same lessons that guide me as Nevada’s governor. I come at this job with a real appreciation for the challenges Nevada families face each day. That’s why, as governor, I fought to increase the minimum wage, reduce prescription drug costs, create clean jobs, and fund public education at an unprecedented level. We can continue the work to help Nevada families. But right now, I’m up against a historic slate of MAGA opponents — the largest field of governor candidates in at least six decades! **[A Republican governor will roll back all the progress we’ve made. Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal and I are leading 22 of our House and Senate colleagues in a letter to Clarence Thomas and Chief Justice John Roberts. We’re calling on Clarence Thomas to recuse himself from any more cases on the attempted coup his wife participated in. And we’re demanding that John Roberts establish a basic, binding Code of Ethics for Supreme Court justices — can you believe that doesn’t exist already? | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43617960/337974323/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ4C_SCO_E_20220331_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODZiZjgzZS0wYmIxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZbBJUtWAaC9NAQ3hD2n8bVfT6Vv48toBzdE9nbSLN2w=&emci=c56bf83e-0bb1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=c86bf83e-0bb1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)

We got some explosive news last week. It was already clear that Ginni Thomas — who’s married to Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas — was involved in Donald Trump’s attempt to overturn the 2020 elections. But now, new reporting exposes how far she went. Newly released texts from Ginni Thomas to Trump’s chief of staff show her spreading false theories about the election, urging him to pull off a coup, and trying to give him pointers. And here’s where Clarence Thomas comes in: earlier this year, he was the only Supreme Court justice to vote against requiring that Trump White House records be turned over to the January 6th House Select Committee. Records that might have included those texts from his wife. But he didn’t disclose anything about his connection to the case, and he sure didn’t recuse himself. He may have violated federal conflict-of-interest law. **Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal and I are leading 22 of our House and Senate colleagues in a letter to Clarence Thomas and Chief Justice John Roberts.** **We’re calling on Clarence Thomas to recuse himself from any more cases on the attempted coup his wife participated in.** **And we’re demanding that John Roberts establish a basic, binding Code of Ethics for Supreme Court justices — can you believe that doesn’t exist already?** [_**Your support means a lot in this fight. Add your name if you agree: Clarence Thomas can’t participate in any more cases about the efforts to overturn the 2020 election, and it’s way past time for the Supreme Court to have to follow a basic Code of Ethics.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43617961/337974324/-980357457?refcode=EMZ4C_SCO_E_20220331_V1S1&ms=EMZ4C_SCO_E_20220331_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODZiZjgzZS0wYmIxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZbBJUtWAaC9NAQ3hD2n8bVfT6Vv48toBzdE9nbSLN2w=&emci=c56bf83e-0bb1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=c86bf83e-0bb1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) I’ve been in this fight for a long time to clear up conflicts of interest at the Supreme Court — and with you by my side, I’m going to stay in it. subject: What drives me?

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresshttps://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331]
Team,
There are a few things that inspired me to first run for office back in 2017. The first was the tone and tenor of our politics after the 2016 election. Something had shifted, and it was alarming to watch.
The second was watching my then-Congressman vote to gut the Affordable Care Act. When my mother was diagnosed with Stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009, she couldn’t afford health insurance due to her pre-existing condition. So when the U.S. House voted to cut protections for people with pre-existing conditions and held a big party to celebrate at the White House, something inside me broke.
These are some of the things that drive me. They’re why I’m so committed to getting out in the new areas of the new 7th district – made up of Ingham, Livingston, Eaton, Clinton, and Shiawassee counties as well as Milford, South Lyon, and 200 folks in Genesee County – to ask voters: what do you want to see from your representative in Congress? I’ve been getting to know people, talking with local business owners, knocking doors, and asking voters that one simple question.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331]
In Congress, I fight to find common-sense solutions to the issues that impact our pocketbooks and our kids – lowering the cost of prescription drugs and health insurance, allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices, bringing manufacturing back to the United States and to Michigan.
But, in order to continue my work, I need your help.
We’re coming up on our first end-of-quarter deadline of 2022 – a year where I’m in one of the most competitive House races in the country, and THE most competitive in Michigan.
With a razor-thin majority in the House, the path to keeping the House runs directly through my new district. Running a strategic campaign in a brand new area requires a massive amount of resources. Will you chip in before tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline to help me keep fighting for Michigan families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331]
Elissa

body:
Peter, **Thanks to the tyrannical Left, America is nearly unrecognizable from the beacon of freedom it once was.**

Parents are being silenced, our elections are under attack, and we have to fight _just_ to be able to enforce our laws.

**America needs a lifeboat, and my team and I want YOU on our team to save it.**

I put together an **11-point conservative plan** to **RESCUE AMERICA** , and we need your support to turn our conservative goals into a successful reality.

[**Pitch in now and join the fight to RESCUE AMERICA from the radical Left.**](http://links.voterickscott.com/u/click?_t=24d1692d4ad14657a18af9ad6ea13243&_m=bf010f7adac640cab8a7bb1e8728dbdb&_e=JF7OuBTK_gAAalYUYqzZu5n3WoXWc8FhhsN3qqEpXAuzpL9YakAv0cBmAGLObMUwZSs3kr5tcZoiNCgjT_jdYBXe5RPateBgPlzMavoQ7izJJQW1iG-0tBE5rP7YDj1pg9YiAW1LIIrGIQnsOPM6F8XTnFOno39DDgsJVtxiZcEx2CJRc4GT2GwFbNIUtJoXNOxm_2-thsdtA5rLdWSsJSaOiLn6R2OWELERmUwiDOg50SUttffjMiU9kwmNcHsEJ7FlN2lLEQmoFgfxuwOTkaIo5xU747g2r9_DVxg0rdVqvo9nWgZ6tjuoK0-dXSW6nr0FNw63gaS3vnVVpDBcIvqBK6NlE5DoJirwMA188wdLubyJhjHbApW3NoIJgQfAVINm0_2wAyotQMeOotdCtHhTG8e5B0VGPzcKkOFaj3k%3D) [**PITCH IN NOW**](http://links.voterickscott.com/u/click?_t=24d1692d4ad14657a18af9ad6ea13243&_m=bf010f7adac640cab8a7bb1e8728dbdb&_e=JF7OuBTK_gAAalYUYqzZu5n3WoXWc8FhhsN3qqEpXAuzpL9YakAv0cBmAGLObMUwZSs3kr5tcZoiNCgjT_jdYBXe5RPateBgPlzMavoQ7izJJQW1iG-0tBE5rP7YDj1pg9YiAW1LIIrGIQnsOPM6F8XTnFOno39DDgsJVtxiZcEx2CJRc4GT2GwFbNIUtJoXuuQ9czH1mFWQ9OSx5Ou3BW4aF9_lg0kDtagaCbeBESvNGj7RMy5OtmGTT13k_dTgnv21ZR_L75vY8JFR3xj6VBAV7F8ijUgd-t4UTIq91X4853tVWQuzB4K2iAyIb6syyImcYiuw-w6vXtOt6HLQW-Fst8pnuDpgDDdBdWpkz726OB2ufHmsz7dDUUFj4n-_tc6L2mVqKJPMNyS6IG8dh60ZVyI6_5Eb5ZRnVuqIF54%3D) Our plan to rescue America is just 11-steps, but it can turn our country around, Peter.

**Here’s what they are:** 1\. Our kids will say the pledge of allegiance, salute the Flag, learn that America is a great country, and choose the school that best fits them. 2\. Government will never again ask American citizens to disclose their race, ethnicity, or skin color on any government form. 3\. The soft-on-crime days of coddling criminal behavior will end. We will re-fund and respect the police because, they, not the criminals, are the good guys. 4\. We will secure our border, finish building the wall, and name it after President Donald Trump. 5\. We will grow America’s economy, starve Washington’s economy, and stop Socialism. 6\. We will eliminate all federal programs that can be done locally, and enact term limits for federal bureaucrats and Congress. 7\. We will protect the integrity of American Democracy and stop left-wing efforts to rig elections. 8\. We will protect, defend, and promote the American Family at all costs. 9\. Men are men, women are women, and unborn babies are babies. We believe in science. 10\. Americans will be free to welcome God into all aspects of our lives. We are Americans, not globalists. ### Michael Brown Releases Transparency and Accountability in Government Plan
“My pledge to you is that every morning in Michigan when the government opens it will be accessible to its citizens,” says Michael Brown, Republican candidate for Governor as he unveiled his “Sunrise Michigan” plan.

“Throughout my public safety career, I have been subject to Freedom of Information Act requests. It’s how it should be in our state government as well,” he stated. “In state government operations there should be nothing to hide.”

Brown’s 8-point plan to ensure government transparency and accountability would **open up the Governor’s office and State Legislature to Freedom of Information Act requests**. Currently only two states exempt their Governor and legislature, and Michigan is one of them.

“Governor Whitmer pledged to open up the Governor’s office, but she has completely failed on her promise,” noted Brown. “During the pandemic, she conveniently hid her actions behind a wall of secrecy.”

“Whitmer could have voluntarily opened her office to FOIA requests, but she failed to do so. She’s only paid lip service to the idea of transparency in government,” he added.

Other points in Brown’s plan include:
* **Closing loopholes** used by agencies to delay compliance with requests;
* **Eliminating the costs** of filing FOIA requests with state government agencies;
* **Establishing an independent board** to review appeals;
* **Ensuring that the Governor’s schedule is public** ;
* **Requiring disclosure** of business dealings with government agencies; and
* **Producing an annual report** to track accountability.

“Excessive costs passed on to requestors is punitive and meant to discourage people from requesting information they have a right to see,” Brown stated. “In addition, many agencies find loopholes to allow them to take their time producing requested materials – sometimes delaying for over a year. This must stop.”

“You should not need an attorney to request information from the government and to hold your government accountable.”

clean_body: “Governor Whitmer pledged to open up the Governor’s office, but she has completely failed on her promise,” noted Brown. | | | | | | | | | | | Michael Brown Releases Transparency and Accountability in Government Plan “My pledge to you is that every morning in Michigan when the government opens it will be accessible to its citizens,” says Michael Brown, Republican candidate for Governor as he unveiled his “Sunrise Michigan” plan. “Throughout my public safety career, I have been subject to Freedom of Information Act requests. It’s how it should be in our state government as well,” he stated. “In state government operations there should be nothing to hide.” Brown’s 8-point plan to ensure government transparency and accountability would open up the Governor’s office and State Legislature to Freedom of Information Act requests. Currently only two states exempt their Governor and legislature, and Michigan is one of them. “Governor Whitmer pledged to open up the Governor’s office, but she has completely failed on her promise,” noted Brown. “During the pandemic, she conveniently hid her actions behind a wall of secrecy.” “Whitmer could have voluntarily opened her office to FOIA requests, but she failed to do so. She’s only paid lip service to the idea of transparency in government,” he added. Other points in Brown’s plan include: Closing loopholes used by agencies to delay compliance with requests; Eliminating the costs of filing FOIA requests with state government agencies; Establishing an independent board to review appeals; Ensuring that the Governor’s schedule is public ; Requiring disclosure of business dealings with government agencies; and Producing an annual report to track accountability. “Excessive costs passed on to requestors is punitive and meant to discourage people from requesting information they have a right to see,” Brown stated. “In addition, many agencies find loopholes to allow them to take their time producing requested materials – sometimes delaying for over a year. This must stop.” “You should not need an attorney to request information from the government and to hold your government accountable.” | | "VIEW MICHAEL BROWN’S SUNRISE MICHIGAN PLAN" | | Paid for by Michael Brown for Governor • P.O. Hi there,

I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself — **I’m Jevin Hodge and I’m running to serve Arizona’s 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.**
| [SUPPORT JEVIN ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43602354/337915795/2116278533?refcode=BLU-HODG-Welcome1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Y2U1NTk2ZS1mNWIwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Y_XF5z-KpbGoT4ltzB9UQ-q1vag-S_lZ_UNCK5mh1I=)

I’m the son of a single mother who made history as the first Black woman elected in the City of Tempe. **Arizona gave my family and me a chance at a better life. But right now, too many Arizonans can’t say the same.**

The last year has demonstrated how important it is for us to have real leadership working for all of us — and how devastating it is when we don’t.

My opponent, Congressman David Schweikert, is a career politician with a track record full of ethics scandals and controversy. We need new representation in this seat, someone who will take on the challenges Arizona families and businesses face — not look the other way.

**So I’m running to replace him.** I’m running because I believe voting rights are civil rights, and that we need to pass HR 1 to defend our freedoms. I’m running because I know health care is a human right — period. I’m running because we need leadership to tackle the climate crisis. I’m running because the 400 wealthiest Americans currently own more wealth than all Black households combined, and we need to change that. And I’m running because we need a renewed sense of leadership to ensure all of our kids have the opportunities they deserve.

**We have so much left to do to ensure America’s promise of a better life for all. I hope you’ll join me in fighting for a better future for Arizona’s next generation.**

More soon,

Jevin D. Hodge

My brother Jazz is counting on grassroots supporters like you to fuel his campaign for Congress, and he needs 31 more people to give before midnight to meet his end-of-quarter goal. Please, will you rush in whatever you can to make sure he gets there? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=top_link1]
Donate now » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=top_btn]
Folks, our parents did everything they could for us growing up.
But as every young Black man knows all too well, we were just one incident away from our lives possibly turning upside down.
My brother Jazz knew that change couldn’t wait. So he ran for Maryland Delegate and helped write and pass landmark police reform and accountability, like banning military-grade weapons in our neighborhoods and requiring body cameras -- and requiring that they are actually turned on.
Jazz is running for Congress because communities across the country can’t wait for this change either. If 31 more people chip in by midnight to his campaign, he will meet his filing deadline goal and be on track to taking the fight to reform our unjust and often predatory criminal justice system to Congress. Can Jazz count on you to step up right now when it matters? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=body_link1]

Look, we didn’t grow up with a lot of money. That means Jazz needs lots of people to give what they can to meet his fundraising benchmarks so he can keep organizing to win this open House seat for progress.
I hope you’ll join me in standing with him and chipping in what you can to make sure his campaign hits this critical goal so he can get to Congress and deliver the results, not rhetoric, that our families need. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_march?refcode2=body_link1]
Thanks for meeting this moment,
Myles Lewis
Jazz’s brother
Jazz Lewis [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/Jazz-Lewis-Portrait.png]
Jazz Lewis is an effective progressive leader running for the Democratic nomination in Maryland’s 4th Congressional District. A champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus.
Jazz would be the youngest African-American ever elected to represent Maryland in Congress. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son.

Peter,

Virtue-signaling Hollywood elitists, the dishonest corporate media, and woke leftists have come together — once again — to force their radical agenda on Florida parents and our children.

They’re either ignorant to the contents of the Parental Rights in Education bill because they haven’t read the legislation and are only interested in spewing false talking points to gain favor from elites, OR they know full-well what’s in the bill and they truly believe 5 year olds should be taught gender identity curriculum in their kindergarten classrooms!

When parents send our babies to school — 5, 6, 7, 8 year olds — we want them to be educated, not indoctrinated with an inappropriate sexualized curriculum, especially without a parents’ knowledge nor consent.

Parents know what is best when it comes to the well-being of our kids. Full stop. Disney is apparently attempting to bully Floridians to get what they want. They are lecturing Florida House and Senate members who voted for the bill, chastising Floridians who overwhelmingly agree with the legislation, and attempting to intimidate our Governor to reverse course. …and that — as you well know — will never happen.

Just this week, Disney admitted in a company meeting that they are seeking to advance a policy agenda through children's entertainment. This is disturbing and wrong.

My message to Disney and the corporate left:Let kids be kids and stop forcing your progressive will on the most innocent in society.

We are in an uphill battle against the liberal machine, and that's why we need your continued support.

Today is International Transgender Day of Visibility, a day created as a celebration of authenticity and humanity.

**Yet, just this week, Pennsylvania’s****GOP-led House panel approved legislation to ban transgender women from competing on women’s high school and college sports teams. **

With trans lives being violently politicized, it’s more important than ever to be seen and claim ownership of our accomplishments, our achievements, and our very existence.

As politicians across the country actively work to discredit and even _eliminate_ our place in this world, today is the day to stand up loudly and proudly and fight back against bigotry in the very buildings where these hateful and strategic attacks are being written into law.

>From the worlds of sports, politics, and entertainment to who we are simply as parents, children, partners, siblings, and friends, trans lives are worth celebrating. **And if we are going to fight back against the vicious and heartless attacks on our lives across state legislatures – particularly on our children – then we need representation now more than ever. **

Being able to turn in nearly three times the number of required signatures to get my name on the ballot for state representative, as a Latina-trans woman, shows that voters recognize the need for representation and are ready to upend the status quo in Harrisburg.

It is time for us to elect trans women of color, who have been on the frontlines of the LGBTQ movement since its inception.

[_Will you help me get to Harrisburg to fight against the attacks on trans lives in the Pennsylvania legislature?_ ](https://dejaforpa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b6353e8c7ba78b936853cab9&id=5fa9cbbd8d&e=3f8e2ea1e3)

body:
Peter —

These past few weeks, we’ve seen what the GOP does to qualified, determined Black women. We saw them harass Ketanji Brown Jackson for days , asking her nonsensical questions at best and downright insulting questions at worst.

But here’s the thing, Peter — it’s not just the GOP.

Rep. Donald Payne Jr., the New Jersey political machine, and the establishment are all doing the same exact thing to Imani.

They’re trying to discredit her, call her unqualified, and belittle her experience — all to distract from the fact that they’d rather cater to special interests than listen to our communities.

That’s why tonight’s deadline is so critical. We need to show the GOP, the New Jersey machine, and the establishment that their racist, sexist political games don’t fool anyone.

We need to stand behind qualified, experienced Black women like Imani and make our LAST end-of-quarter deadline count. Can you chip in $27 right now to help us do it? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-io-march2022?refcode=eoq5]

subject: A special session?
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Peter —

We were going to send you another email about our March deadline, but DeSantis is at it again, and we need to talk about it.

This week, DeSantis decided that the GOP’s hyper-partisan redistricting maps weren’t bad enough — so he VETOED them, calling for a special session to redraw district lines to suit his political whims.

Instead of using Florida’s budget surplus to help working families, fight the affordability crisis, or lower gas prices, DeSantis is wasting taxpayer dollars with a special session to rewrite maps that his GOP allies wrote in the first place.

This is exactly what we’re fighting against, Peter. DeSantis won’t be satisfied until he, alone, holds full control over our state. And we need to stop him before it’s too late. Will you rush a $10 donation before tonight’s deadline to help us do it? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-mar-2022?refcode=331eom8]

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately.

While DeSantis was busy playing dictator this week, Nikki was representing us in the Cabinet and working on real issues that impact Florida families.

That’s the kind of leader we need — a leader who listens to us, not a leader who redraws maps until he’s silenced every single dissenting voice.

If you agree, we hope you’ll chip in $10 to help us meet our March fundraising goal and keep up our fight against DeSantis’ authoritarian dictatorship. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-mar-2022?refcode=331eom8]

Thank you for standing with us.

— Team Nikki

name: Steve Sisolak
subject: I'm counting on your urgent support, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
My core value of public service – why I ran for governor – comes from a lesson my dad used to tell me: You need to leave your community better than you found it.
| | |
---
**I need your help, friend:** While Dean Heller and my other extremist Republican opponents align themselves with Donald Trump, I've spent my time as Nevada's governor working to make our state a place of opportunity for _everyone_ – from protecting voting rights to rebuilding an economy that uplifts working families.
But election experts are saying that Nevada is one of the states most likely to flip red, and both _The Cook Political Report_ and _U.S. News & World Report_ just ranked my race for governor a toss-up. That's why, with Republicans spending over _$2_ _million_ to defeat me, I'm counting on your urgent grassroots support to fight back and keep this seat blue.
**But with time running out before tonight's crucial FEC deadline, we're still falling way short of our $15,000 goal. [So I'm personally asking: Will you give $5 or more right now – split between our campaign and Jacky Rosen's – to help me defend Nevada's toss-up governor seat and keep our battleground state blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43627037/338010427/-1013490552?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1693-bu-nd-v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2M4ZWYxMC0xZGIxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q0OXFwCnxv-4ST55G-uKVTVXevrLzkgFzyxH2RBuKsI=)**
My core value of public service – why I ran for governor – comes from a lesson my dad used to tell me: **You need to leave your community better than you found it.**

On average, a gallon of gas in New York right now costs almost $4.50 — that’s a HUGE burden on working people to bear on top of suppressed wages, rising food costs, expensive healthcare premiums, and energy corporations jacking up rates to make a quick buck.
Big Oil companies want you to believe that these rising gas prices are due to Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. But that flies in the face of reality: **the U.S. is the biggest global producer of oil** and oil is priced by global markets.
Here’s the deal:
🎈When prices go up and a company’s profits stay proportional or shrink, that’s inflation.
💰 When prices go up and a company’s profits explode, that’s __price gouging__.
We KNOW that oil companies are making record profits right now. But instead of working to balance the market, oil executives are investing their profits in stock buybacks and sticking consumers with these big price increases at the pump.
So what can we do?**Pass a Windfall Profits Tax.** Oil companies who take advantage of the war in Ukraine to pad their bottom line will be subject to a tax on their price-gouged profits. That tax would then go back to the American people in the form of a quarterly rebate. Under this bill, gas and oil companies will still make a nice profit, **but they won't be able to take advantage of Americans still struggling to recover from the effects of a global pandemic.**
It's time to end the corporate greed, and I intend to do exactly that when I get to Congress. clean_body: | | | | Let's talk about gas prices, Peter Willis. But really quick before we get into it — On average, a gallon of gas in New York right now costs almost $4.50 — that’s a HUGE burden on working people to bear on top of suppressed wages, rising food costs, expensive healthcare premiums, and energy corporations jacking up rates to make a quick buck. Big Oil companies want you to believe that these rising gas prices are due to Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. But that flies in the face of reality: the U.S. is the biggest global producer of oil and oil is priced by global markets. Here’s the deal: 🎈When prices go up and a company’s profits stay proportional or shrink, that’s inflation. 💰 When prices go up and a company’s profits explode, that’s price gouging. We KNOW that oil companies are making record profits right now. But instead of working to balance the market, oil executives are investing their profits in stock buybacks and sticking consumers with these big price increases at the pump. So what can we do?Pass a Windfall Profits Tax. Oil companies who take advantage of the war in Ukraine to pad their bottom line will be subject to a tax on their price-gouged profits. That tax would then go back to the American people in the form of a quarterly rebate. Under this bill, gas and oil companies will still make a nice profit, but they won't be able to take advantage of Americans still struggling to recover from the effects of a global pandemic. It's time to end the corporate greed, and I intend to do exactly that when I get to Congress. Friend, The stakes for 2022 are escalating. You've seen that multiple Republican candidates in Michigan are running on Trump's Big Lie platform - lying to Michigan citizens about the results of the 2020 election and using those lies as a springboard for their own celebrity and power. They will likely be the nominees for both secretary of state and attorney general.

Make no mistake: We're facing a serious, sophisticated, well funded multi-year, coordinated effort to dismantle our democracy. We are facing an authoritarian movement funded and spearheaded by the DeVos family and Donald Trump. They have shown us time and time again that there is no line they won't cross, no bottom to how far they will stoop to undo the very fabric of our country.

If we don't win in 2022, one of Trump's hand-picked people will likely be in charge of Michigan's elections for 2024. We already know what will happen then. Just look at what they tried in 2020. And now Trump’s coming back to Michigan to campaign for multiple extremist candidates – that shows he’s all-in to take over our state’s political and legal systems.

I need your help and that’s where you come in. We need to ensure every voter in this state knows the choice they will have this fall: Do they want their voice heard and their vote to count or do they want a conspiracy theorist who will take away both, no matter who they voted for? The choice will be plain and simple: democracy or autocracy? Please make a contribution today to make sure I can keep fighting to defend our democracy.

Thank you for all your support. I can't do this without you.

-Jocelyn

# Washington Free Beacon: Warnock Calls for Ending Fossil Fuels in Unearthed Video

"In a newly unearthed video from 2020, Democratic senator Raphael Warnock (Ga.) said the United States needs to move away from using fossil fuels and that he's open to discussing a carbon tax to get there. The video, which will be used as part of an [ad campaign](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001T2gtQ_roPHZChGTbxxaTHm5UvdwG4uLLSmYE-Q87Cpt4oN1CnCYPXqw22-PTEddwoeVz4vMX-dci_3tNoWoghM-pQMYUbbjnSbhj1UMtnlT99c78vee6QaWLcNHUC8hSA740HFzm0q3W5q-AIj-I-fjG8fsnewa7aF4UJzmfRkCII026IxhwxA==&c=3O_pqTonrxOJgz7ZmEjr6xylE-UwK0b8Ir-3YDsyrNOglZq2tD1Gvw==&ch=vQ7cTtx7FIFtO-nCiQyGwTrjv480k2CYr9CrZ6QwIniJsu6wb6t6Bw==) by 34N22, a super PAC supporting Warnock's Republican opponent Herschel Walker, comes as Warnock has worked to position himself as moderate on energy issues amid skyrocketing gas prices in Georgia and around the United States.34N22, the pro-Republican super PAC that unearthed the video, told the Free Beacon that it will be highlighting Warnock's comments as part of a "six-figure digital ad buy." "Raphael Warnock helped kill the Keystone Pipeline and American energy development--causing Georgia's gas prices to spike and our country to lose its energy independence," said 34N22's Stephen Lawson. When our numbers go public, Republicans will comb through every line of our report looking for signs of weakness. With FOUR extreme GOP candidates now in the race, it's absolutely critical that we report strong numbers.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I'll get right to it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
There's so much on the line in this consequential midterm election year, and we can't afford to fall short:
#
Hey Peter — my campaign manager Lauren just called to let me know we're still quite a few donations short of hitting our $35,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal before tonight's deadline — the first FEC filing deadline of the year.
So I'll get right to it: [**Will you chip in $3 or any amount before midnight to help power our work for our progressive agenda, protecting our Democratic majority, and electing even MORE bold progressives to Congress?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11742?refcode=em20220331-1145&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1145%2E420207%2EfMf7n8)_There's so much on the line in this consequential midterm election year, and we can't afford to fall short:_
**[Contribute $3 »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11742?refcode=em20220331-1145&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1145%2E420207%2EfMf7n8)**
Democrats have accomplished some big things in the face of special interests and corporate spending — but we know that there’s still so much more we need to get done. And next January, a new Congress will be sworn in. Before that happens, we must do everything in our power to deliver for our communities while protecting our Democratic majorities.
When you make a donation to our grassroots campaign, you're showing up for our urgent fights on Medicare for All, bold solutions to the climate crisis, humane immigration reform, a wealth tax, affordable housing, and so much more. [**Will you chip in $3 or any amount toward our end-of-quarter fundraising goal? Your donation will help our fight for working people to stay strong.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11742?refcode=em20220331-1145&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1145%2E420207%2EfMf7n8)

I am always so grateful for your support, Peter. Together we have achieved so much since I was first elected to Congress in 2016, and together we'll continue to fight for bold and transformative change.
In solidarity,
Pramila

body:
Meaningful change will only happen if we are in this together.
#

Friends -
Since my shooting, I’ve learned that making progress requires imagination and persistence—the ability to envision a better future, and the doggedness to see it through, even when change happens slower than we’d like.
In my recovery, I visualized myself being able to walk on my own and find the words to communicate again. And I kept that image in my mind through long hours of occupational and speech therapy.
Now you try: Imagine a world without gun violence.
Imagine sending our kids to school without fear of a mass shooting. Imagine neighborhoods where families and communities feel safe. Keep that image in your mind and it will help you keep up the fight!
This is tireless work, but it is worth it. I promise you. The hardest fights always are. But meaningful change will only happen if we are in this together.

We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money. You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen. But now we have a new mission: Re-election. And right now, the polls are really tight. If we’re going to win again and keep control of the Senate, it’s going to take a similar level of grassroots support from people like you. So please: = | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you again. For everything. Mark Kelly (This is a sponsored send hosted by CommonGood. CommonGood is dedicated to helping Democratic campaigns and organizations win critical races in Virginia and across the country.) body:

|
#### **Barrett Records Last Flight with the U.S. Army**
This week I went on my final flight mission with the United States Army. I spent 22 years serving this great country and I could not be more thankful for the opportunities that I have had while in uniform. I deployed to Iraq, Kuwait, South Korea, and Guantanamo Bay, and had the opportunity to go to flight school to become an Army National Guard helicopter pilot.I am honored to have been able to fight alongside incredible men and women - but I am ready for my next deployment to Washington D.C. as your next Congressman.See more [here](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6245c2026049006a56ff1e33&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fbarrettbrigade1%2Fposts%2F417931200141292&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=EtGsy7sNse6ttnmYRrhGTL0I4mI%3D).

---
#### **The Biden-Slotkin Green Agenda Threatens Economic, National Security**
Former Congressman Mike Rogers hit the nail on the head in his recent Detroit News op-ed. The Biden-Slotkin green agenda will kneecap the American energy sector and make our country weaker on an economic and national security front. We must unleash American energy and make our country energy independent again. The best way to ensure America is safe and prosperous is to put us back in the drivers seat of our energy production.See more [here](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6245c2026049006a56ff1e33&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fbarrettbrigade1%2Fposts%2F417627366838342&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=CssTGDOaxajWpqCLVTpWuyHuF8w%3D).

| [](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6245c2026049006a56ff1e33&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fbarrettbrigade1%2Fposts%2F417627366838342&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=CssTGDOaxajWpqCLVTpWuyHuF8w%3D)
---
#### **Senate Adopts Barrett Resolution Calling for End to Public Transit Mask Mandates**
The Michigan Senate adopted my resolution to end mask mandates on public transportation. **Important Deadline This Thursday**
Our campaign to chart a new path for Oregon is gaining momentum every day. That momentum is in large part due to your support. Thank you for your help. A lot of people have invested time, money and effort in this campaign to retire the senior senator who has been part of the DC establishment for more than 40 years. I am so humbled to be the person who gets to be the tip of the spear in that effort. We are working hard to get around the state of Oregon. In the last two weeks we have been to Joseph, Imbler, Vale, Roseburg, Eugene, Sisters, Bend, Dundee, Salem, Tigard, Condon, Pendleton, La Grande, Elgin and probably some other places that I’ve missed. Getting to visit the great and unique parts of our great state is one of the most enjoyable parts of this campaign to bring Oregonian values to the US Senate. If you have a group, association or community group that I could visit in the next few weeks please let our team know. I would love to visit your community too. Please let us know by emailing us at [_info@harbickforussenate.com_](mailto:info@harbickforussenate.com). One of the stark realities of running a statewide campaign is the need for financial help. We continue to be blessed by individuals who have stepped up to support our campaign by donating their hard earned dollars. We are facing an end of the 1st quarter fundraising deadline on Thursday. Could you help us defeat the Biden & Wyden policy agenda by making a contribution before the end of the day Thursday? Your contribution of $100, $250, $500 or more will go a long way to send the message to our opponents that our effort has broad support. You can donate directly here - [_https://www.efundraisingconnections.com/c/Harbick/_](https://harbickforussenate.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3dd8e7fd3b4e92c0bcc1988f&id=759b89dc30&e=97f786938b) Thanks again for your ongoing support. Hi ,
One of the most important things I’ve learned running (and winning) statewide before is that early money can make the difference between winning and losing. We can use what we raise right now to make smart investments in staff, expand our ground game and more.
So if you can use this link to give, it’d mean a lot to me: [**https://CheriBeasley.com/March-FEC](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-mar22?refcode=em220331-1-T1&refcode2=647.357359.N6vhs7&t=1&akid=647%2E357359%2EN6vhs7)**
Look, we’re trying to do something different in North Carolina, and your support truly matters if we’re going to succeed. We’ve seen too many campaigns try the same old playbook only to fall short on Election Day.
But we believe that our priority at every stage must be the people of North Carolina. That’s why we’ve been focused on meeting with voters across the state — listening to North Carolinians about their needs and what they want in their next U.S. Senator.
We’re building a campaign that is for North Carolina and about North Carolina, and that’s how we will inspire and turn out voters from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike, and flip this seat.
The support we’ve received so far has put us in a strong position. It’s truly humbling to think about the thousands of folks who’ve backed our campaign.
But Republicans are pouring limitless sums of dark money into our state as we speak. There is more pressure on our campaign than ever before.
