From: Emma Bouton (Matt and Cynthia for RI)
Date: Tue, Mar 29, 2022, 1:20 AM
Subject: The truth about “End of Quarter” deadlines

Hi Friend,
Fundraising deadlines can seem arbitrary (I certainly thought they were before I began working on political campaigns), so I want to take a moment to share why Thursday’s End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline is particularly crucial before asking if you’d consider chipping in again.
**1\. Fundraising numbers are**** _the main piece of information_****that the press and national endorsers use to assess if a campaign has a shot at winning.** While this can be frustrating because we know that many other things – like our policy platform and grassroots organizing in communities across the state – say a whole lot more about how Matt and Cynthia will govern and how they can win, it’s true that campaigns need a lot of resources to get across the finish line. And good press coverage and national endorsements are hugely helpful both for future fundraising and for getting our message out to voters.
**2\. End-of-Quarter fundraising numbers have a long-lasting impact on perceptions of a campaign**. Because fundraising quarters are three months long, and then the numbers don’t get reported publicly for another month after that, our numbers at the end of March will be used by the press and everyone else to assess our campaign’s momentum for the next 4 months (until new numbers are released at the end of July!). That’s why it’s vital that we have strong fundraising _now_.
I honestly wish that politics didn’t work this way, and that candidates’ ideas and ability to connect with voters were seen as more significant indicators of their ability to win. That’s why public financing and getting money out of politics are a key part of our policy platform, and will be a priority of Matt and Cynthia’s once in office.
**[But in the meantime, we have an urgent deadline to meet on Thursday (3/31) with big consequences for our campaign. Governor, but to send nurses, teachers, social workers, and community leaders to the State House and build something this country has never seen before: a progressive, multiracial, cross-class government. Fundraising numbers are the main piece of informationthat the press and national endorsers use to assess if a campaign has a shot at winning. While this can be frustrating because we know that many other things – like our policy platform and grassroots organizing in communities across the state – say a whole lot more about how Matt and Cynthia will govern and how they can win, it’s true that campaigns need a lot of resources to get across the finish line. And good press coverage and national endorsements are hugely helpful both for future fundraising and for getting our message out to voters. 2\. End-of-Quarter fundraising numbers have a long-lasting impact on perceptions of a campaign. That’s why it’s vital that we have strong fundraising now. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Tonight is the Federal Election Commission (FEC) deadline for candidates
and committees to report their fundraising numbers to the public. Right
now, establishment politicians are doing everything they can to strengthen
their FEC report by taking money from mega-donors and industry PACs.

This deadline doesn’t apply to us at Justice Democrats, but it does apply
to corporate Democrats like Henry Cuellar, Danny Davis, Kyrsten Sinema,
and Joe Manchin. In order to defeat them, we need to keep pace with their
fundraising and hit our end-of-quarter goals.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101100?refcode=em20220331-22648&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=22648%2E1203867%2EObikMT ]Will you chip in $3 to help us meet our end-of-quarter
fundraising goal and fully fund our work to elect a slate of diverse,
working-class champions to Congress? This is the first end-of-quarter
deadline of the year, and we need to raise big to power our primaries in
the coming months.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101100?refcode=em20220331-22648&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=22648%2E1203867%2EObikMT ]Contribute $3

Justice Democrats have already changed the conversation on so many issues,
from health care to the climate crisis, and have faced many tough fights
in Congress. We won’t let up until we win a Green New Deal, Medicare for
All, cancel student loan debt, and secure other victories for working
people.

We’re up against corporate PACs, the Democratic and the Republican
establishment, and billionaires who want to continue to profit off our
broken systems. They will all spend big this year to halt progress. But,
with your support, we can win this fight to transform the Democratic Party
and elect fierce champions of working-class values who will join the Squad
in Congress.

Justice Democrats

From: Kelvin King <kelvin@kelvinking.com>
Date: Tue, March 29, 2022 at 6:30 PM
Subject: Georgia deserves strong leadership.
To: Paige Smith <paige@warroom.gop>

Friend,

We're seeing in real-time how President Biden and the Democratic Party continue to fail the American people, both domestically and internationally. We see the rising costs from inflation every time we buy groceries or fill up our cars at the pump. We need strong leadership on the international stage, not the daily gaffes we're getting from Democrats now.
The Democratic Party is more concerned with pushing its destructive, far-left agenda than helping hard-working American citizens. Whether it is pushing CRT in our schools, or unnecessary federal spending and regulations, the Democrats are only concerned with expanding government control and woke culture. It is more important than ever that we elect a candidate who is prepared to take on the liberal left and fight to preserve the American dream.

The citizens of Georgia deserve a qualified and accessible candidate who can #retireWarnock, and I believe I am that candidate - but we can’t do it without your support!

We're just two days away from our **March 31st fundraising deadline**. [Will you help us hit our goal?](https://gop.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435843e25393f24c78349b03f&id=34d3b6d4db&e=7bbb93570f)

With this one seat, we can take back control of the Senate and begin repairing the damage done by the Democrats. Our campaign team is working day and night to spread our message, but we need your help. [I ask that you please consider supporting my campaign with a contribution of $1,000, $500, $250, $100, or any amount you can do.](https://gop.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435843e25393f24c78349b03f&id=c2bbdea419&e=7bbb93570f)

Together, we can win for Georgia and #WinforAmerica!

Respectfully,

* Economic stability
* Safe communities

body:
[1]Charles Booker

This is it, Peter.

I know you’re just as hungry as I am to defeat Rand Paul and finally end
the dysfunction we’ve witnessed for too long in our Senate.

That’s why I’m reaching out personally to ask for your help in this
fight.

Our FEC deadline is tonight at midnight and we’re just a handful of
donations away from hitting our $20,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17568?refcode=em20220331-other-1708&t=1001&akid=1708%2E346206%2ENEaSWl ]It’s critical we hit this end-of-quarter goal if we want to be ready
for a competitive election and pull off a grassroots victory this year.
Please chip in $5 or anything you can afford — your donation
can be the one that pushes us over the edge.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17568?refcode=em20220331-other-1708&t=1002&akid=1708%2E346206%2ENEaSWl ][IMG]

I can’t emphasize enough how huge it would be for our progressive movement
if we hit this goal.

It’s so much more than reaching a number. When you give $5 to our campaign
it’s a powerful way of saying that you:

Stand with our fight to pass Medicare for All, to make sure every family
has a fair shot at the American Dream, and to enact a climate crisis
response before it’s too late for our planet.

Reject the corporate influence that’s dominated our politics for too
long.

And believe that we the people deserve much more than Rand Paul’s lies,
misinformation, and corruption.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17568?refcode=em20220331-other-1708&t=1003&akid=1708%2E346206%2ENEaSWl ]Rand Paul, the media, and the GOP will be watching whether we hit our
goal. I’m hopeful that we’ll show them that this movement is ready to
fight. Can I count on you to pitch in before the deadline?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17568?refcode=em20220331-1708&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1708%2E346206%2ENEaSWl ]DONATE $5 NOW →

I hate to be blunt, but also want to remind you how consequential it would
be if we fall short tonight.

body:
Peter,

It’s Paul, Josh’s Dad.

I’ve never written a political email before, and I’m not a very political person, but I wanted to write because I’m so proud of the work Josh has done and the work he’ll do in Congress if elected.

My wife and I raised Josh with the values that if you work hard, play by the rules, and treat others with respect, then you’d get a fair shot at success. Josh has embodied those values, as well as the belief that we are at our best when we work together toward a better world for all of us.

When Josh was in high school, he added a paper route to his daily schedule. He had to wake up at the crack of dawn in all kinds of weather conditions to deliver newspapers throughout the neighborhood. He then went to school and earned good grades and attended football or lacrosse practice every night, all before returning home for dinner and homework. In college, he had a work-study and a full load of coursework. In law school, he maintained those values and work ethic, which led him to a fellowship on the Labor & Pensions Committee in the U.S. Senate and to volunteer at a legal aid clinic in New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina, helping workers who had lost their jobs.

After law school, Josh chose a law practice that allowed him to continue his public service work ethic. He went to Florida to represent children and families who faced barriers to obtaining medical care.

Josh has demonstrated what it means to work hard and care for others throughout his life and career. I know as a Member of Congress, he’ll fight tirelessly for all of the people whom he will represent. Josh and his team are certainly putting in the hours every single day to introduce him to the people who can send him to Congress.

Here’s one more thing I know about his campaign: tonight is their biggest fundraising deadline of the entire campaign.

So, if it’s in your budget to make a contribution today, I hope you’ll chip in a few bucks to help power his team’s work for the next three months of the race >>

I’m grateful that Josh has so many committed friends and supporters backing him every step of the way, just like me.

Thank you,

Paul Riley (Josh’s Dad)

| Peter Willis,

At **Our Revolution** we don’t just preach about building power, we’re advancing our progressive mission on every front — on the ground, at all levels of government, and within the Democratic Party itself.

Since 2016, our members have been doing the work transforming the party into a more progressive party. We’ve eliminated superdelegates on the first ballot, established the first-ever DNC Climate Crisis Council, and recruited members to help lead state and local parties.

We’re making a difference, but we have to go further. Ultimately, we must reverse the top-down power structure of the DNC and release the party from the grip of corporate elites and a money-driven consultant class undermining our work.

“When superdelegates are back on the table — that should raise alarms", Our Revolution Board Member and Nebraska party chair **Jane Kleeb** said on our Monday Night Live Broadcast. “We need structural change, and we need the votes to back up our fight.”

**That’s why I joined Jane and other Our Revolution leaders to form a reform group inside the DNC.** We’re organizing to recruit over 100 members before the DNC’s fall meeting, where we aim to impact party rules and the 2024 presidential primary calendar.

[ Change happens from the bottom-up, and Our Revolution and other grassroots leaders _within the DNC_ need our help to remake politics from the inside-out. Can we count on you to pitch in and support this work to empower the grassroots and transform the mechanics of politics?](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5000?amount=15&refcode=OR_EM_FR_WLS_20220331_2_16&t=11&akid=2762%2E5885482%2E406sVR) _If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Our Revolution will process immediately._ | | [DONATE $15 NOW »](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4859?amount=15&refcode=OR_EM_FR_WLS_20220331_2_16&t=12&akid=2762%2E5885482%2E406sVR)

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresshttps://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2]
Friend,
Tonight (!!) is our first end-of-quarter deadline of 2022! This is our first chance of the year to show the strength of this team to anyone looking to flip this seat.
But don’t take our word for it. Elissa laid this out in the email she sent earlier, so we’re writing to make sure you saw... and to ask if you’ll chip in $5, $10, or $15 before tonight’s deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2]
Together, we can show anyone betting against Elissa that it just isn’t worth their time.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2]
Team Slotkin
Team,
There are a few things that inspired me to first run for office back in 2017. The first was the tone and tenor of our politics after the 2016 election. Something had shifted, and it was alarming to watch.
The second was watching my then-Congressman vote to gut the Affordable Care Act. When my mother was diagnosed with Stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009, she couldn’t afford health insurance due to her pre-existing condition. So when the U.S. House voted to cut protections for people with pre-existing conditions and held a big party to celebrate at the White House, something inside me broke.
These are some of the things that drive me. They’re why I’m so committed to getting out in the new areas of the new 7th district – made up of Ingham, Livingston, Eaton, Clinton, and Shiawassee counties as well as Milford, South Lyon, and 200 folks in Genesee County – to ask voters: what do you want to see from your representative in Congress? I’ve been getting to know people, talking with local business owners, knocking doors, and asking voters that one simple question.
secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2 [secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2]
In Congress, I fight to find common-sense solutions to the issues that impact our pocketbooks and our kids – lowering the cost of prescription drugs and health insurance, allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices, bringing manufacturing back to the United States and to Michigan.
But, in order to continue my work, I need your help.
We’re coming up on our first end-of-quarter deadline of 2022 – a year where I’m in one of the most competitive House races in the country, and THE most competitive in Michigan.
With a razor-thin majority in the House, the path to keeping the House runs directly through my new district. Running a strategic campaign in a brand new area requires a massive amount of resources. W ill you chip in before tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline to help me keep fighting for Michigan families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220331_2]
Elissa

So after 50 years of being virtually empty, I built up our oil reserves during my administration, and low energy prices, to 100% full. It’s called the Strategic National Reserves, and it hasn’t been full for many decades. In fact, it’s been mostly empty. It’s supposed to only be used for large-scale emergency or conflict. body:
I’ll keep this short.
#
I’m sure you get a lot of emails, so I’ll keep this one short, Peter.
We saw last week how pivotal it is that Democrats control the Senate – even by a slim margin.
It was an honor to chair Judge Jackson’s historic nomination hearings. But I shudder to think about how things would have gone had the Republicans been in charge of this process.
Right now, Republicans are campaigning on an extreme agenda that would repeal the Affordable Care Act and raise taxes on millions of American families. We can’t let them win.

body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

I'll be short and direct....
[If you will give Judicial Watch your support today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUv)...we can have an even greater impact.
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUv)
---

Because with your help today, I promise to continue to fight hard on issues you care most about like the following:

* Our ongoing FOIA document requests and litigation to expose the use of taxpayer dollars to promote the indoctrination of public school students with the Marxist, racist teachings of Critical Race Theory.
* Our civil rights lawsuits on behalf of three public school teachers who were fired solely because they dared to express opposition to Critical Race Theory and other woke programs in their schools and school districts.
* Our highly successful mission to keep elections honest and help reduce the incidence of voter fraud by compelling states to comply with federal law to take reasonable steps to keep their voting rolls accurate. We are currently suing Colorado and Pennsylvania following successful lawsuits in several other states, including our recent settlement with North Carolina in which a Judicial Watch lawsuit caused that state to remove over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls... _and more lawsuits are coming_!

As far as I'm concerned, we can't ever do enough to fight for the rule of law and honest and open government. When it comes to using the courts to support the rule of law and government transparency, Judicial Watch is still the "only game in town."

But we weigh carefully each of our investigations and lawsuits against our actual resources, because we take our budget realities very seriously.

And since we are routinely opposed by taxpayer-funded lawyers and bureaucrats in the Deep State "permanent government" who fight against us and for government secrecy with bottomless resources it's essential that we're always prepared.

[That's why your support is so important](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUv)...because knowing that we are strong financially makes it easier for us to commit to aggressive legal and investigative agendas.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUv)
---

Personally, I can't think of a time in our twenty-eight-year history that a strong Judicial Watch has been more important to our nation. That's why [I hope you will make a contribution and join with us today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUv)

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

This past month, Biden’s nominee to the Supreme Court, Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson, sat before the Senate for questioning. The Supreme Court is a sacred institution, and it is critical we appoint justices who are committed to _upholding_ — not making — the law. But what we heard from Judge Jackson and learned about her record this past week should alarm constitutional conservatives everywhere.

When asked about her judicial philosophy, she [told](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=7e22cbe0ff&e=6dcd2506d1) the Senate Judiciary Committee, “I do not have a judicial philosophy.” I’ve argued before the Supreme Court, and this is what concerns me the most about Judge Jackson’s nomination. We don’t need another activist judge on the court who will use their position to push their own radical, progressive agenda. We need constitutional originalists like Justice Thomas and the late Justice Scalia who understood the importance of upholding the law and strict adherence to the Constitution.

When the woke liberal mob is shutting down speech they don’t like all across the country, we need justices who will protect the rights of individuals to freely express themselves. The Arizonans I talk to are concerned about the Supreme Court protecting free speech and, like me, are wondering if Judge Jackson is committed to upholding the First Amendment.

Judge Jackson’s record on immigration law has impacted Arizona directly. In 2019, she [blocked](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=d9abe93b3a&e=6dcd2506d1) the Trump administration’s move to expedite deportations of individuals in the country illegally. We can’t afford to have a justice on the court who will threaten the security of Arizona’s border and refuse to uphold the rule of law. But that is exactly what Biden and Cartel Kelly want.

Fortunately, the United States District Court sided with Arizona and [granted](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=2114359af0&e=6dcd2506d1) a preliminary injunction to stop a harmful immigration policy which would’ve halted nearly every deportation. We can’t have a justice on the bench who will put illegal immigrants before the American people. That’s why as your next Senator, I’m committed to voting for justices who respect our Constitution and uphold the rule of law.

There’s a few days left to gather signatures. This is a great chance to show the momentum on our side. body:
Two-year house terms push everyone into a perpetual election mode.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220331-2912-header&t=1&akid=2912%2E2526796%2E9q6iD_)
**Let's take a moment to talk about the reality of campaign finance for House members like Alexandria.**
Two year terms allow for the House to be the most responsive body to the people – it’s one of the many reasons it’s called “The People’s House.” But because of this, House members are perpetually in election mode (unlike Senators who are allotted six year terms).
For many House members, that means they have to spend more time fundraising and less time governing. **But that’s not the case for Alexandria – thanks to all of you. She said:**
_**“I am lucky in that you all support me through small dollar donations and that gives me a lot of time to focus more on work than many other [members] get.”**_
Every small-dollar contribution to our campaign allows Alexandria to spend her time on what matters – preparing for hearings, writing legislation, meeting with communities – and less time fundraising.
That’s why your donations, no matter what amount, make a huge difference for what Alexandria is able to do in Congress.
Today at midnight, we close the books on our final FEC report before the New York primaries this June. **It is crucial that we give Alexandria an extra boost before this important deadline so that she can continue to focus on her much needed efforts in Congress.**
[Can we count on you to chip in whatever you can right now to support Alexandria in Congress and help us post the strongest FEC report possible?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220331-am?refcode=em20220331-2912-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2912_2526796_9q6iD_&akid=2912%2E2526796%2E9q6iD_)

Hello, Peter, I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself. My name is Paul de la Peña and I’m John’s new campaign manager.

I’m thrilled to have joined this campaign at such a critical time in the race — and I'm even more excited by all the enthusiasm and support for John’s campaign and vision that I am seeing on the ground.

There’s a lot of potential here, Peter, and I’m here to help us see this race through to the finish line.

The first step to growing this campaign so it can reach its full potential is hitting deadlines — like this End of Quarter deadline this evening — so we can reach more Texans, win this campaign, and flip TX-23.

With all the hope I’m seeing for Lira and our vision, I know we can raise $12,731 by tomorrow night — can I count on you to help us get there? Every dollar gets us one step closer to blowing this goal out of the water.

Hi Peter, Everything we’ve been working for is on the line today. Midnight is the official FEC Fundraising Reporting Deadline, the only one before voting begins. [You can make a Citizen Donation online here](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar31_final&n=2). I’ll be honest, things have been so intense at the State Capitol this month that I haven’t been able to devote as much time to raising funds for the congressional campaign. So after a very strong first two months, which established us as the frontrunner, we are in danger of falling below that brisk pace. That would be exactly the kind of opening our opponents are hoping for. In order to keep up our strong pace, today has to be our biggest day yet. If you can help out, in [whatever amount you can](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar31_final&n=3), the full force and effect of your support will be greater today than any time in the campaign. I know you are prudent with your funds, so I want to be fully transparent about the impact of your investment:
* First, it immediately makes our campaign stronger, since a robust war chest acts as a deterrent against our opponents launching attacks.

* Second, it prevents us from having to reduce our budget, which would mean reaching fewer voters through our TV ads, mailers, and volunteer materials.

* Third, it provides me an instant source of inner strength. Knowing you are by my side fighting with me is energizing and motivating beyond words.

If you can give as much as you can before midnight tonight, it will truly, tangibly increase our chances of success. It will help set us on a clear path to victory. [With voting just over a month away, I’d be tremendously grateful for your help](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar31_final&n=4). We’ve fought many battles together. We’ve had victories against all odds. If today goes well, we’ll just be getting started. With hope and resolve,
Kevin p.s. As of this moment, we have received 9,811 citizen donations. [Reaching 10,000](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar31_final&n=5) will make a major statement about the power of a grassroots, citizen-backed campaign.

body:
At midnight tonight, we're closing the books on fundraising for the first quarter of the election year. My team and I set an ambitious online fundraising goal to reach before then, but we're coming up a little short. Peter,

At midnight tonight, we're closing the books on fundraising for the first quarter of the election year. My team and I set an ambitious online fundraising goal to reach before then, but we're coming up a little short.

We can't afford to miss this goal. Washington's 8th District is not only the most competitive district in the state – but it will be one of the closest races in the entire country. Election experts are calling it a "toss-up."

National Republicans think WA-08 is one of their best pick-up opportunities in their efforts to retake the House majority, and they're going all-in to defeat me. The National Republican Congressional Committee just launched a new set of digital ads attacking me and we know many more attacks will come my way over the coming months.

I believe that maxim still rings true today, and that’s why I’m asking you to send a few dollars to my campaign if you can.

For Country,

Rod Dorilás

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

Peter, since the start of the year, a LOT has happened.
* Gas prices are higher than ever.
* The cost of groceries is through the roof!
* Inflation is at a 40-year high.
* Americans are struggling...

body:
Bill McSwain announced on Thursday that he has received the endorsement of Sean Parnell. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billmcswain/sean-parnell-endorses-bill-mcswain-for-governor?e=b1ec95759b)
---
| |
---
| **PRESS RELEASE
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
---
**March 31, 2022
CONTACT: Rachel Tripp
202.738.9089**
---
| |
# Sean Parnell endorses Bill McSwain for Governor
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today announced that he has received the endorsement of best-selling author and combat veteran Sean Parnell.

McSwain had this to say about the endorsement:
---
|
> **_"I am proud to receive the endorsement of my fellow veteran Sean Parnell, who has been an outspoken defender of our conservative values, constitutional liberties, veterans rights, and an advocate for hard-working families across the Commonwealth. Driven by our shared conservative principles, we will work towards victory in November and a safer, freer, more secure Pennsylvania for generations to come."_**
---
| Sean Parnell echoed these sentiments and praised McSwain as the best candidate to lead Pennsylvania into a new era of prosperity:
---
|
> **_"Bill McSwain is a conservative outsider, a fighter and fellow veteran who served his country in the U.S. Marine Corps and as President Trump's U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. As Governor, Bill will restore law and order, fight threats from the left to our constitutional liberties, and bring much needed election integrity back to our Commonwealth by repealing the unconstitutional no-excuse mail in voting law, Act 77. It's not every day that you see an Army Captain cheering on a Marine Platoon Commander, but in this case, I am proud to cheer Bill on and give him my full endorsement."_**
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=7d306c59e5&e=b1ec95759b)

body:
You came through at the close of 2021, now it's time to step up again to make the first quarter of 2022 a success! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/64bafdbb5f88/a-strong-finish-to-8871046?e=f8a0a76a2b)

---
|
> | | |
> ---
> * * *
> * * *
> **At Midnight Tonight the First Fundraising Quarter of Election Year 2022 Closes!**
>
> Toward the end of 2021, supporters of my campaign really stepped up! You helped me close my first quarter as a political candidate with a record showing, raising more money for a Republican candidate in Maine's First District than anyone expected. For that, I am very grateful.
>
> My opponent doesn't worry about the close of a fundraising quarter. As a member of Congress, she routinely votes for policies that result in the unchecked printing of money. As a candidate for her 7th term in office, she might as well be able to print her own money. No Republican candidate in the history of her becoming an entrenched member of Congress has been able to keep pace with her money wand.
>
> We can still beat her even though she can raise millions from the same sources that have financed Progressive Nancy Pelosi for decades. This is Maine, not San Fransisco. We don't need untold millions to hold our own. We have the people on our side! We are building a huge team of volunteers. A Red Wave can be built through the hard work of Team Thelander! But first, we need your continued financial support in order to build that team.
>
> Please step up again, by midnight tonight, March 31st. Consider a donation of $20.22, or $202.20, or $2022 if you are able! If you can, do a little fundraising of your own by sharing this email with friends and family.
>
> Many of us in District 1 have been frustrated at the political dominance of well-heeled Progressives. But everything seems to be lining up for a Red Wave to hit Maine, and America, this year.
>
> Hit the red button and help Build a Red Wave!
>
> Thank you,
> _**\- Ed Thelander**_

We’re *so close* to hitting our FEC fundraising goal but we need your help.
#
We’ll get straight to the point:
We’re **only a few hours away** from our critical FINAL FEC fundraising deadline before our primary election on May 17, and we want to take a moment to update you on where we stand:
[](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47654?t=1&akid=1050%2E3698%2EAWhc1x)
We’re ***SO CLOSE*** to reaching our $40,000 fundraising goal, but we still have a gap to fill before tomorrow. **If just 127 people who read this email donate $20 we’ll reach our fundraising goal before the deadline.**
**If you’re able, will you use your personal link to chip in $20 or anything you can today:**
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-em20220331-ericasupporters?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com-1**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47654?t=2&akid=1050%2E3698%2EAWhc1x)
It’s essential that we reach this critical goal and post strong fundraising numbers for the quarter since they’ll be shared publicly with EVERYONE.
Posting a strong report will show North Carolinians and folks nationwide that our campaign is a force to be reckoned with — especially to those who want to count us out. It will show voters on the fence that Erica has a real shot at winning this race and get them out to the polls in May.

name: George Bochetto
subject: DEADLINE - We need your help
body:
Today marks the last day of the quarter and the final fundraising deadline before the May Primary Election.

|
---
Peter, Today marks the last day of the quarter and the final fundraising deadline before the May Primary Election.

**Now, more than ever,** **we need your support**. My opponents are spending millions of dollars every week trying to convince you that they’re conservatives - Bull! Help us get our message on the air \- and keep it on the air - from today until Election Day. **Will you help us RIGHT NOW with a contribution of $20?** [](https://bochettoforsenate.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYhRECXP9zpGAeiJcLx1o7CFULDvFQHgtUZnpAZW9LK18_cJ1t1AHdBs7o_ggEln7h_BGDEhCTVCGA11SyU0VuRk4w0rmGTNgLakS1BHLXEN2&e=674a0be7cca5db25cb3914af0eb7eb00&utm_source=bochettoforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_quarter&n=1) The past few months have shown that Pennsylvanians want a **_real_** conservative serving them in the U.S. Senate and aren’t content with the pretenders trying to buy the office. My only shot at winning this race is by having your support and the support of many other conservatives in Pennsylvania who believe:

* **That we must reject radical, liberal policies that dangerous criminals loose on our streets put America's greatness in dire jeopardy.**

* **That the Biden/Harris Administration’s open border policy threatens our national security and our way of life.**

* **That we must protect the unborn.**

As an infant, I was left on the doorstep of the Angel Guardian orphanage and lived with the Sisters of Mercy. If Roe v. Wade were law at the time I was born, I may not be here today. I believe in respect for our laws. I believe that criminals belong behind bars. And I believe that we should support law enforcement - **that’s why FOP lodges around the commonwealth have endorsed my campaign.** [](https://bochettoforsenate.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYhRECXP9zpGAeiJcLx1o7CFULDvFQHgtUZnpAZW9LK18_cJ1t1AHdBs7o_ggEln7h_BGDEhCTVCGA11SyU0VuRk4w0rmGTNgLakS1BHLXEN2&e=674a0be7cca5db25cb3914af0eb7eb00&utm_source=bochettoforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_quarter&n=2) The outcome of this year’s election will fundamentally change our country for the better or for the worse. How we choose to move forward is up to us. **With your help, I will defeat the pretenders on the right and the radicals on the left and ensure that every hard working Pennsylvania family has the best shot at a better life.** I'm George Bochetto and I'm grateful to you for joining our team. Thank you for your support and your trust. Let’s win this race! [](https://bochettoforsenate.nationbuilder.com/r?u=eXhars9CjdI-GJ0ZP_vepEn7Wo5bgdOnwIyNB0mb144&e=674a0be7cca5db25cb3914af0eb7eb00&utm_source=bochettoforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_quarter&n=3) George Bochetto
Bochetto for Senate · PA 19102, United States
This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://bochettoforsenate.nationbuilder.com/unsubscribe?e=674a0be7cca5db25cb3914af0eb7eb00&utm_source=bochettoforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_quarter&n=4).

| | | Dear D. P.,

Yesterday, I released the following statement regarding my campaign.

**Centurion: I give Katie Arrington my Complete Endorsement to Replace Mace!**

Due to family health issues, I must unfortunately suspend my campaign.

My time as a candidate greatly increased my love and appreciation for the people and culture of the First Congressional District. The warmth and kindness that has been shown to me by supporters eager to cheer me on and help my campaign has been personally transformative, and for that I will always be grateful.

And while I am suspending my own campaign, my mission remains: to help replace Nancy Mace with a conservative worthy of representing the great patriots of the Low Country.

As a female combat veteran who spent her career in the US Army, I’m guided by a simple strategy: study the battlefield, determine where you can make a difference, and go there. And that has led me to my decision to give my complete support and endorsement to Katie Arrington.

Katie Arrington is a proven fighter for conservative, America First values. While Nancy Mace has betrayed our values and our culture on issues like the right to life to protecting women’s sports and spaces, I know that Katie will stand against the toxic woke agenda that is destroying our country.

I also know that she will make taking care of our veterans a first priority. It is personally important to me that our nation keep its promises to the many who’ve served and sacrificed for our freedom.

I love all of my supporters dearly, and now I urge them all to help us complete our mission: vote for Katie Arrington in the Republican Primary so we can REPLACE MACE!

Ingrid Centurion is available for comments and interview at ingrid@centurionforcongress.com or via phone at 843.330.3610.

Thank you and God Bless,

body:
| Hey team, before you head to bed, I wanted to send one final email before our midnight deadline.

Republicans know Ohio is a crucial tipping point in 2022. So they've set their sights on doing everything they can to hold on to their control of our state. But, if we can build a strong grassroots team, we'll be able to fight back.

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Fwd: official deadline approaching
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
Friend: I hope you didn't miss my message below. With extreme Trump loyalists challenging me in this race - hoping to dismantle Democrats' control of the Senate and hand the chamber back to Mitch McConnell - donations are pouring in to keep this seat in Democratic hands. I'm now just $2,332 short of my official FEC deadline fundraising goal - but with the GOP going all in to capture this seat, close is not enough. We absolutely cannot fall short.
---
At this point, we have just mere hours to make up this shortfall. I know that, as an important member of this grassroots team, you care deeply about protecting and expanding Democratic Senate control. **[That's why, with so much on the line - and a big FEC deadline before us - I'm counting on you to make a donation before it's too late. Will you give $5 or more right now so we can hit this goal, protect this Democratic seat, and expand Democratic control of the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1162-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Richard Blumenthal**
Date: Wed, Mar 30, 2022
Subject: My first official FEC deadline of the election year

[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=zNNxaP6ZAuqsLqG2o87v3BS2673Oy7cX&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend, my campaign is coming up on the first official FEC fundraising deadline of the election year. Republicans only need to flip one seat to take back control of the Senate, so Mitch McConnell and his allies will be watching us closely for any sign of vulnerability - and unfortunately, right now, we're forecasted to fall $7,621 short of our Q1 goal.
Before I continue, I want to say this: I am so appreciative of your continued support. Whenever I make an important ask, you step up. Thank you.
**But please also take stock of the urgency of this moment: An FEC deadline means we have to publicly report our fundraising. If we fall short, that could signal to Mitch McConnell and the GOP to pile on their attacks here and make this Democratic seat a top target for defeat.**
We simply cannot be in that position - not when the stakes are so high. Not when I'm facing radical, Trump-loyalist opponents who - if elected - would obstruct President Biden's Supreme Court nominees and work to shield Donald Trump from any accountability whatsoever for his potentially criminal behavior in the White House.
Not when Rick Scott, the leader of the GOP Senate campaign arm, is waiting in the wings to pass a radical, 11-point plan that would be a _disaster_ for our country - a plan that includes tax hikes on millions of seniors and low-income Americans, disgraceful attacks on reproductive freedom, and a commitment to not only resume construction of Trump's vanity border wall project, but to actually _name the wall after the disgraced former president himself_. Make no mistake: A Republican Senate majority would be a nightmare for our country.
**That 's why we _must_ come through on big goals like this. Hitting this goal will not only show the strength of our Democratic campaign, but also ensure we have the tangible resources to bolster our operations and _expand_ Democratic control of the Senate. For reproductive rights, for climate justice, for accountability for Donald Trump, and for so much more, we must rise to the moment.**
**_Your_ donation, Friend, could ensure we close our budget gap.**
Because you're someone who cares deeply about protecting Democratic Senate control, I know you'll take this seriously: [Please, before my end-of-quarter FEC deadline, can you chip in $5 or more to defend this Democratic Senate seat and keep Democrats in control of the Senate? The months ahead will be challenging, and we need grassroots resources here and now to compete.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1162-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1162-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
With so much gratitude,
Dick
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com.
[To unsubscribe from the Blumenthal for Connecticut email list, please click here.](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=7D3rkn36hzz6KaghbL5uDRS2673Oy7cX&url=http%3A%2F%2Faction.richardblumenthal.com%2Fp%2Fsalsa%2Fsupporter%2Funsubscribe%2Fpublic%2Findex.sjs%3Funsubscribe_page_KEY%3D550%26Email%3D%5B%5BEmail%5D%5D%26email_blast_KEY%3D%5B%5Bemail_blast_KEY%5D%5D)

Fellow Conservative,

I’ve been fighting for you and for the truth since I first was elected to Congress in November 2006. Since then, the voters of Ohio’s 4th Congressional District have continued to put their faith in me and have sent me back for two-year stints ever since.

I have never - and will never - take a single vote for granted. I will continue to work hard for every single vote; I’ve watched a lot of people lose their jobs because they forget who they report to; the American people.

**I will never take the position I currently hold for granted**.

For as long as the folks I represent continue putting their faith in me, **I’ll keep fighting every single day to make America a better version of itself.**

Val Demings can't afford to miss a single fundraising deadline during this critical moment – especially not when Senate control is on the line – but she's falling short of her midnight deadline.

**Friend, will you help my friend Val Demings make history as Florida's first Black senator?**
As the daughter of a maid and a janitor, she knows the value of hard work. After spending her entire career working tirelessly to expand opportunities for families like her own, she’s ready to take her efforts to the Senate – and **she’s got what it takes to win.**

But, friend, let me be perfectly clear about why I'm asking you to donate to Val Demings today: Florida Senate races are always close – and the GOP is fighting with everything they have. In 2021 alone, the Senate Republican campaign arm raised **$104 MILLION **to take back the Senate – and they have been pouring millions into attack ads against Val Demings.

**That’s why I’m reaching out. Because in a race this tight, every dollar matters. Val Demings is a tough, dedicated leader who has what it takes to flip Florida blue, and she needs your help _right now_ _ _ to keep her momentum going. [_Please, will you rush $5, $25 or whatever you can spare to her campaign? **If we can band together now to help Val Demings win this race, she’ll not only make history – she’ll also expand our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority. I’m excited for the chance to work alongside my longtime friend, but she can’t win Florida alone. **

| | Dear ,
I’m worried. [There are less than 24 hours left until our midnight fundraising goal and we are just $12,620 short of our fundraising goal.](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=9a82a40f0a&e=44b8c466b0)

**I am disappointed that we have not gotten there yet, but I have not given up hope. [I am looking for a few proud patriots to stand up for election integrity today.](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=7897f04142&e=44b8c466b0)**

My name is Mark Finchem and I have been fighting for Election Integrity since day one, and there is a hell of a lot of fight left to go.

We have:
* Fought for the Maricopa audit, exposing widespread fraud
* Pushed for perpetrators of election fraud to be brought to justice.
* Helped start nationwide audits around the country
* Supported America first candidates in statewide and national elections
* Developed and pioneered powerful anti-fraud technology through currency grade watermarking for ballots
* Spoken at Trump’s rallies in support of the America First movement
* Done all of this while still serving as a Representative in Arizona and supporting Conservative, America first policies legislatively.

**All I can ask is this: What more can I do?**

_Every single day I ask that question, and every single day I push harder for election integrity. What more do you need to see that I care deeply about Election Integrity and will do whatever it takes?_

**I am working for you and the American people every day to fight back against the fraud that occurred in the 2020 election, and we have made huge strides.**

[_But this is a team effort..._](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=346e37e52e&e=44b8c466b0)

**_[And I cannot finish the job without your help!](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=dd1700db46&e=44b8c466b0)_**

I have until midnight tonight to raise $12,620. [We’re almost there, but I really need your help. Even a donation of just $25, $50, or $100 would show that Election Integrity still has a chance!](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=8ce1588538&e=44b8c466b0)

[Please donate whatever you can](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=d73b9043a9&e=44b8c466b0) to help me win the fight and CRUSH the first fundraising deadline of the year.

I’m trying to feed a family of 6 in Biden’s economy. I feel the pain as I fill up the minivan. I’m stretched thin and I’m tired of working hard every day just to have my money wasted on these Liberal anti-math, anti-freedom policies. **But this is our reality unless we win control of Congress and take our country back.** I promise you that Tom will spend your hard-earned donation the way a Conservative should - with integrity. | | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you’ve even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation’s history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America’s future. For this reason, we have produced the **Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum** —and I’m writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum? ** The**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College—and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the **Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum** is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the **Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum** available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $400,000 to promote the**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum** and our other outreach efforts—including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative. _ That’s an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you—citizens who agree with Hillsdale’s mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale’s 177-year-old mission—to provide “sound learning” of the kind needed to preserve “the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty.” With that mission in mind, we produced the **Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum** —and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty?**_ Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty—and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty—I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I’ve included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](https://for.az.kelliward.com/link.php?AGENCY=PMI&M=22208987&N=150928&L=82306&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtaGlsbHNkYWxlLTE3NzYtY3VycmljdWx1bT91dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTE3NzZfY3VycmljdWx1bSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRV9LZWxsaVdhcmQwMzMxMjAyMiZzYz1NSzEwMjFFTTI=)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Your support is so important to our success. With just a few more hours left until we close the books for the quarter. I wanted to take the time to clarify what I mean when I say that the current representation does not reflect the make up of this district.
Virginia’s 8th is incredibly culturally diverse. As a daughter of Ecuadorian and Indian immigrants, I understand the needs of immigrant communities in our district. I, like many children of immigrants, grew up going to work with my mom at the nail salon, translated documents for my parents, and recently, I fulfilled the ultimate dream of supporting my parents after a successful career in tech.
And being born and raised in Virginia’s 8th, I’ve seen the hardship that any evolving district goes through as housing becomes less affordable, the climate is on the decline, and the current job market is only widening the wage and class gap. These are real issues plaguing our district.
There are many voters in this district who are passionate about taking action and I am too. I want to fight for families who want to raise a family in Virginia’s 8th. I want to make environmentally conscious options more accessible to our residents to ensure that we are doing our part to save our planet. I want to be a voice and advocate for all of Virginia’s 8th and not the select few.
My opponent is the fourth richest man in the House of Representatives. I’ve never been the fourth richest in anything monetary, but I know what it is like working hard for what I want and reaching my goals.
There is no self-funding or corporate connections to fund my campaign . So this is my last plea before my last major FEC deadline. Please make a contribution today so we can fight for representation that reflects the makeup of Virginia’s 8th congressional district. The truth is, when I got back from Iraq, two things quickly became apparent to me.
#
Derek -
In just a moment I am going to ask you to make a donation to VoteVets before our midnight FEC deadline ends. I hope you'll give me a chance to explain why this request is so important.
The truth is, when I got back from Iraq, two things quickly became apparent to me. The first is that for a long time there was this myth that to be a veteran meant your views were inherently conservative and that Republicans used that myth to advance their views politically and electorally. Remember the Swift Boat Veterans?
I knew that wasn't true, and there someone needed to be out there speaking for progressive veterans and military families.
The second realization was that there just weren't enough progressive veterans in Congress.
We started VoteVets to change both of those things. And this year we have a chance to advance both of those causes: to help elect progressive veterans, and to elevate the voices of veterans in support of progressive candidates and ideals.

__
# MEET DERRICK GATES
__ Hello Friends, My name is Derrick Gates, Republican candidate for Congress in the now 36th District. Many people may not know yet, but the 33rd has now changed to 36th. While the district number has changed, the objective has not - to beat Ted Lieu. I would like to introduce myself to you and talk about why our campaign represents the best shot we have had to beat Lieu since he was first elected. I’m a husband, father, Christian, American patriot, small business owner, minister, and community leader. I am far from a perfect man - I have no hesitation admitting that. I tackled my flaws head-on, had an intimate run-in with Jesus Christ, and turned my life around. Since the moment I met Jesus, I have dedicated my life to the ministry where I counsel those who are
struggling, sit beside those who have lost their loved ones, help the less fortunate, and even kick down doors to physically pull people out of crack houses. My wife and I feed the hungry, house the homeless, turn former prisoners into productive members of society, and help the addicted get clean. We do all of these things while being forthright in our faith and belief in limited government, conservative principles, and pro-family values. We help our community, but we also defend the Constitutional rights of Americans, advocate for the unborn, fight for medical freedom, and are vocally supportive of the restoration of personal freedom and parental rights. My life experience and consistent defense of our shared values, combined with the political environment of this midterm election, provides us with a unique opportunity. Make no mistake about it - we can do what Republicans did in New Jersey and Virginia this past November. 2022 is undoubtedly going to be a wave year - so why not us? But I can’t win this race alone. We all know that campaigns are a costly endeavor, and with my family’s financial resources dedicated to our ministry, I need the help of patriots like you. Can you contribute $25, $50, $100, $250, or any amount you can afford today? To contribute, [click here](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/416378?id=20751.104.1.ad1e551ea47c4ff979d0b3c13bdbb615). Together, we can show Los Angeles that America First means People First.
Thank you and God Bless, Derrick Gates P.S. If you would like to discuss my campaign, give me a call at 424-216-6893. Learn more about Derrick and see his endorsements so far below.
[www.officialderrickgates.com](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/416378?id=20751.105.1.17da2519bc20218158f6697fa0e413ce).

clean_body: Fellow American, Most members of Congress wouldn’t last a day as a U.S. Green Beret. How can they be expected to serve the American people when they’re barely willing to stand up to our socialist enemies? Congress needs a kick in the behind to GET TO WORK and do their jobs, and I’m ready to give them just that - but I need your help. Our FIRST end of quarter deadline of our race is HERE, and if we don’t make this goal, we’ll NEVER be able to bring our Green Beret values to Washington. Over my time in the Army, I got used to seeing everyone not just do their jobs, but strive to be the best they could be for our country. When I got out, I realized that our leaders in Congress weren’t doing the same. They’re taking punches from the radical Left and not even turning the other cheek. They’re letting enemies like Vladmir Putin and the Taliban make a mockery of the greatest country on Earth. And they’re letting America’s strength slip between their fingers while they dine at 5-star restaurants. It’s time for a new generation of conservatives who will put their nose to the grindstone and work for America, not their egos and wallets - but we can’t start a Republican revolution without your help. Democrats Serve is a national organization that backs Democrats running for office with frontline public service backgrounds, including first responders, firefighters, social workers, police officers, prosecutors, judges, public defenders, educators, and more.

Democratic candidates with professional experience serving their communities in government have a pragmatic approach to governing and know how to get things done, making for strong narratives and an ability to connect with voters uniquely.

However, when running for office, they often lack access to the professional campaign staff and wealthy donor networks that non-working class candidates do.

To help level the playing field, Democrats Serve was born. Since launching in May 2021, of the 29 endorsed candidates who have appeared on a ballot so far, every single one has won their election.

For the 2022 midterms, the PAC has made endorsements nationwide in competitive elections, including: U.S. Senate Candidates Cheri Beasley (NC), Val Demings (FL), and Sarah Godlewski (WI); U.S. House Candidates Christina Bohannan (IA-01), Matt Castelli (NY-21), Jasmine Crockett (TX-30), Val Foushee (NC-06), Kara Hahn (NY-1), Jonathan Logemann (IL-17), Seth Magaziner (RI-02), Karin Norington-Reaves (IL-01), Ruben Ramirez (TX-15), and Tony Vargas (NE-2); Incumbent House Democrats Carolyn Bourdeaux (GA-07), Jahana Hayes (CT-05), Andy Kim (NJ-03), Tom Malinowski (NJ-07), Tom O'Halleran (AZ-01), Katie Porter (CA-45), Mikie Sherrill (NJ-11), Abigail Spanberger (VA-07), Elissa Slotkin (MI-08), Lauren Underwood (IL-14), and Susan Wild (PA-07); Gubernatorial Candidate Katie Hobbs (AZ); and Attorney General Candidate Aramis Ayala (FL).

name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Before midnight, chip in for our challengers
body:
These fundraising numbers are so important
#
Peter,
We only have a few hours left before the midnight FEC deadline — when our 2022 progressive primary challengers will need to once again make their fundraising numbers public.
**Here’s why that’s important:** Three of our endorsed candidates — Rana Abdelhamid, Kina Collins, and Summer Lee — are in tough races with steep fundraising challenges. We’re facing a political establishment funded by Wall Street, Big Pharma, and fossil fuel companies. That’s not how Justice Democrats do it. Rana, Kina, and Summer are relying on grassroots support, not taking a single cent from corporate PACs.
**Media and political insiders are all waiting to see if our challengers can raise enough from small-dollar donations to keep pace with the corporate-backed establishment candidates.** If we raise the money our slate needs to keep pace, we can build winning campaigns AND keep up momentum so the media doesn’t ignore us.
**[So, we need your help before midnight. It’s our last chance to boost Rana, Kina, and Summer’s fundraising numbers before the FEC deadline. It will set the tone for the critical final stretch of our primaries in 2022. Can you chip in $3 before midnight?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101164?refcode=em20220331-22659&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=22659%2E1203867%2Em32XZ9)**
**[Contribute $3](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101164?refcode=em20220331-22659&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=22659%2E1203867%2Em32XZ9)**
At this moment, every dollar counts and brings us closer to our shared vision for equity and justice for all.
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=21&akid=22659%2E1203867%2Em32XZ9) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=22&akid=22659%2E1203867%2Em32XZ9) and your state public health department.
---

body:
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220331-2914-header&t=1&akid=2914%2E2526796%2EmlvUQ5)
In a moment, we’re going to lay out why a $3 contribution from you — especially before tonight’s midnight deadline — would make a significant difference for our work together, but **if you’re ready to chip in now, please make a contribution below to your personal link:**
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220331-pm?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220331-pm?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20220331-2914-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2914_2526796_mlvUQ5&akid=2914%2E2526796%2EmlvUQ5)
Here’s the work your $3 contribution is funding:
* **Preparing for a tough re-election:** Our race was the second most expensive House race in the country in 2020 — Republicans spent more than $10 million trying to unseat Alexandria. As she continues to use her voice in Congress to fight for progressive change, we need to prepare for another massive and expensive race funded by wealthy special interests.
* **Building resources to make local and community-focused impact:** Community organizing is how our movement stopped the NRG fracked gas plant from being built in the backyards of Queens residents; it’s how we educated folks on the importance of filling out the Census and saved New York a congressional seat; and it’s how we raised millions of dollars for relief when disaster hit our communities — from The Bronx to Texas.
* **Passing progressive policies:** Alexandria and our movement recently helped pass legislation to provide millions to grassroots organizations and other public institutions in The Bronx and Queens, so they can fight gentrification, reduce maternal mortality, help kids hurt by the pandemic graduate high school, apply community-driven solutions to violence, and create one of the first ever Green New Deal workforce training programs.

Alexandria can’t do this work alone. She needs a movement alongside her. And when we receive enough support from small-dollar donors to hit each and every monthly goal, we can carry out our full strategy to expand our movement and keep Alexandria in Congress fighting to enact progressive change in the years to come.
**If everyone who is reading this email chips in $3 — or anything they can today before our midnight deadline — it’ll ensure we can report a strong quarterly fundraising report to the Federal Election Commission and show our opponents that our grassroots movement isn’t going anywhere. If you’re able, will you use your personal link below to make a $3 contribution today?**

Together, there’s nothing we can’t accomplish.
Thank you,
Team AOC

The Pathway Forward | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/webvortex/its-official-shes-off-and-running-8863297?e=bb02dd73bf)
---
| | | [ ](https://centurionforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=986079a9d70593df507cfab3a&id=6f1c78d254&e=bb02dd73bf)
---
| | | Dear D. P.,

I want to thank all my volunteers over the past eight months! I am so blessed to have gained your trust. You were all in with me on this mission to #ReplaceMace. I knew this was going to be a challenge and I am not quitting my efforts to fight for the First Congressional District's conservative values. I am taking a momentary pause right now due to my mother's health. Her dementia has seriously progressed and her health is the most important to me. I cannot dedicate all my energies to the people of the District. I have always stated Family comes first and taking care of my mother is dear to my heart.

I refuse to sit on the sidelines during a time in history when we need Americans to take action and get behind an America First Candidate. I am not a politician and I must take a side to support the candidate who is a fighter. Katie Arrington has my full support. I would like to host an appreciation party for everyone. Please join me at my new home in Goose Creek. For those around the country who can't make it I will connect with you via Zoom online during the event so that you may join in with us. Details will be sent soon. If you have any questions, please feel free to call me at anytime.

Thank you for your support and God Bless,
---

clean_body: The Pathway Forward | | | | | | | | | | Dear D. P., I want to thank all my volunteers over the past eight months! I am so blessed to have gained your trust. You were all in with me on this mission to #ReplaceMace. I knew this was going to be a challenge and I am not quitting my efforts to fight for the First Congressional District's conservative values. I am taking a momentary pause right now due to my mother's health. Her dementia has seriously progressed and her health is the most important to me. I cannot dedicate all my energies to the people of the District. I have always stated Family comes first and taking care of my mother is dear to my heart. I refuse to sit on the sidelines during a time in history when we need Americans to take action and get behind an America First Candidate. I am not a politician and I must take a side to support the candidate who is a fighter. Katie Arrington has my full support. I would like to host an appreciation party for everyone. Please join me at my new home in Goose Creek. For those around the country who can't make it I will connect with you via Zoom online during the event so that you may join in with us. Details will be sent soon. If you have any questions, please feel free to call me at anytime. Thank you for your support and God Bless, | | | | | | | Team Centurion continues in the fight!! | | | | | | Ingrid Centurion America First conservative Republican.
